title: How Far Are We From On-Device VLM Inference? A Measurement Study on Edge NPUs
comment: 26 pages, including references and appendices
summary: Diverse optimizations spanning model architecture, inference runtime, and hardware acceleration have been proposed for on-device vision-language model (VLM) deployment on edge NPUs. Still, cross-layer coordination of VLM execution on edge NPUs remains largely underexplored. This paper presents an empirical measurement study across six representative VLMs, three real-world edge platforms, and ten multimodal benchmarks. Our evaluation drills down from end-to-end application-level latency and thermal traces down to low-level kernel-scale execution behaviors, challenging several widely held community assumptions. First, softmax dominates attention costs; even lookup-table-based softmax optimizations cannot eliminate pipeline bubbles that severely underutilize NPU matrix units. Second, theoretical speedups from linear attention vanish under real-NPU execution due to prohibitive tensor-rearrangement overhead. Third, no hardware backend universally dominates autoregressive decoding: attention-tensor-shaped parallelism dictates NPU efficiency and shifts the CPU-NPU performance balance. We further find task-specific Sweet Resolutions for VLMs, which deliver meaningful accuracy gains at only modest latency overhead. Complementing these findings, we provide actionable cross-layer recommendations for hardware architects, runtime developers, and model designers.

AI.tldr: 本文对6个代表性VLM、3种边缘NPU平台、10个多模态基准进行端到端到kernel级的实证测量，挑战了关于attention开销、线性注意力加速和硬件后端优势的三条社区假设，并发现任务相关的"Sweet Resolutions"。
AI.motivation: 现有优化分散在模型架构、推理运行时与硬件加速各层，但VLM在边缘NPU上的跨层协同执行仍缺乏系统性理解，社区依赖的多项工程直觉可能失真。
AI.method: 构建跨层测量研究：覆盖6个VLM、3个真实边缘平台、10个多模态基准；从应用级端到端时延与热轨迹逐层下探至kernel级执行行为（含算子级profiling与pipeline分析）。
AI.result: （1）softmax主导attention开销，基于查表的softmax优化仍无法消除pipeline气泡，导致NPU矩阵单元利用率严重不足；（2）线性注意力的理论加速在真实NPU上因张量重排开销而消失；（3）无普适最优硬件后端，attention张量形状决定的并行度左右NPU效率并改变CPU-NPU性能平衡；此外发现任务相关的Sweet Resolution，能以较小延迟代价换取显著精度提升。
AI.conclusion: VLM边缘NPU部署需跨层协同设计；论文为硬件架构师、运行时开发者与模型设计者给出可操作建议，如针对pipeline气泡的调度/融合、关注张量重排代价、按attention形状定制并行策略与分辨率配置。

title: NORmal: Architecting 3D Ferroelectric NOR Flash as Main Memory -- From Co-Fabricated BEOL Arrays to 200B-Class Multi-Agent LLMs in a Smartphone
comment: 13 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables
summary: Smartphone agents increasingly work as teams, in which a large planner directs parallel workers across long sessions. Running such a team on the device requires 200B-class models and contexts that exceed phone DRAM many times over, yet existing tiers treat flash as storage: UFS starves per-token weight streaming, and mobile High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) needs a redesigned SoC and cannot absorb continuous KV writes. We show that a non-volatile memory can join an unmodified LPDDR6 bus as a plain rank only if its access latency fits the DRAM timing window, a condition no NAND tier meets. We present NORmal, to our knowledge the first main-memory architecture for 3D ferroelectric NOR flash. We have fabricated and experimentally characterized back-end-of-line (BEOL) 3D FeNOR arrays that co-integrate dense 3-bit MLC and fast, high-endurance in-place-writable SLC with sub-7.5 ns sensing. NORmal turns these co-fabricated arrays into a byte-addressable, deterministic-timing load/store rank on an unmodified LPDDR6 interface through an under-array DRAM-emulation bridge, staggered bank reads with zero-cycle weight swizzling, and posted SLC writes. Across this rank and DRAM, NORmal places agent state by mutability and lifetime rather than by hotness, serving 200B-class models and persistent planner contexts in place while dynamically partitioning subchannels across agent phases. In serving-level simulation on production agent traces, NORmal is 8.9$\times$--28.0$\times$ faster than UFS offloading, within 0.4% of an unlimited-DRAM ideal, and 2.8$\times$--6.3$\times$ faster than HBF on sessions beyond 256K tokens, with 8.1$\times$--17.8$\times$ less memory energy per token.

AI.tldr: NORmal 是首个面向 3D 铁电 NOR 闪存（FeNOR）的主存架构，通过将 BEOL 共集成的 3-bit MLC 与亚 7.5 ns SLC 阵列经 DRAM 仿真桥接入未修改的 LPDDR6 总线，作为普通 rank 提供字节可寻址的确定性访存，并按"可变性与生命周期"而非热度为智能体状态分层，使手机端可原地服务 200B 级模型与长上下文规划器。
AI.motivation: 手机端智能体团队（大规划器 + 并行 worker、长会话）需要 200B 级模型和远超手机 DRAM 容量的上下文。现有分层方案把闪存当存储：UFS 带宽不足，无法支撑逐 token 权重流式加载；移动 HBF 需重新设计 SoC，且无法承接持续的 KV 写入。作者指出，只要访问延迟落在 DRAM 时序窗口内，非易失存储器就能作为普通 rank 挂上未修改的 LPDDR6 总线，而现有 NAND 层级均不满足该条件——这构成了本文的核心设计机会。
AI.method: 硬件层面：流片并实验表征 BEOL 3D FeNOR 阵列，同一阵列共集成高密度 3-bit MLC 与高耐久、可原地写入的 SLC，感测时间低于 7.5 ns。系统层面：通过三个机制把该阵列变为 LPDDR6 上字节可寻址、时序确定的 load/store rank——(1) 阵列下方 DRAM 仿真桥，(2) 交错 bank 读取与零周期权重 swizzling，(3) posted SLC 写。数据放置策略：跨越该 rank 与 DRAM，按可变性和生命周期（而非访问热度）划分智能体状态，权重与持久规划器上下文原地驻留，并按智能体阶段动态划分子通道。
AI.result: 基于生产级智能体 trace 的服务级仿真显示：相较 UFS offloading 快 8.9×–28.0×；与无限 DRAM 理想方案差距在 0.4% 以内；在超过 256K token 的会话上比 HBF 快 2.8×–6.3×；每 token 内存能耗降低 8.1×–17.8×。
AI.conclusion: 满足 DRAM 时序窗口的非易失存储可无缝并入现有移动主存总线，3D FeNOR 依此成为可行的"第二主存"。以可变性/生命周期为准则的状态放置与子通道动态划分，可将现有移动端内存层级从"容量受限"推进到接近无限 DRAM 的服务水平，同时显著降低能耗，无需改动 SoC 或 LPDDR6 接口。

title: LAMP: LLM-Driven Analog Placement through Adaptive Tool Composition
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 1 table
summary: Analog placement requires circuit-specific trade-offs among area, matching, routability, and electrical performance. Balancing these trade-offs through predefined objectives and fixed placement flows remains difficult. In this paper, we propose an analog placement framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as a layout engineer through composable placement components. These components support constraint management, placement and legalization, and lightweight evaluation of routability and electrical performance. Using multimodal checkpoints of the initial and evolving design, the LLM selects and combines components to construct and revise its own placement flow. It also adapts the placement hierarchy by reopening modules or partitioning and regrouping devices, allowing local layouts to respond to global design needs. An experience skill provides reusable design knowledge to guide these decisions. Evaluation on two SMIC 180 nm circuits shows that the framework reduces placement area and improves most measured post-layout performance metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出以LLM充当"版图工程师"的模拟电路布局(placement)框架，将约束管理、布局与合法化、可布线性与电性能轻量评估封装为可组合放置组件；LLM依据初始与演化中设计的多模态检查点选择并组合组件，构建与修订自有布局流程，并通过"打开模块/划分并重组器件"自适应调整布局层级，辅以可复用的经验技能引导决策。在SMIC 180nm的两个电路上降低了布局面积并改善多数测得的后版图性能指标。
AI.motivation: 模拟版图需要在面积、匹配、可布线性与电性能之间做电路相关的权衡；仅靠预定义目标函数与固定布局流程难以平衡这些权衡。作者希望让布局流程本身能够按电路特点被动态构建与修订，从而更灵活地处理冲突目标与全局/局部设计需求。
AI.method: 1) 将布局能力解耦为可组合组件：约束管理、布局与合法化、可布线性与电性能的轻量评估；2) 以LLM作为决策主体，输入初始与迭代演化设计的多模态检查点(版图/检查信息)，由其选择与组合组件，构建并修正专属布局流程；3) 支持层级自适应：重开(重新打开)已放置模块，或将器件划分重组，使局部布局响应全局需求；4) 引入经验技能库作为可复用设计知识，指导组件选择与层级调整决策。
AI.result: 在SMIC 180nm工艺的两个电路上进行评测，结果表明该框架减小了布局面积，并在大多数所测后版图性能指标上取得改善；同时验证了LLM驱动的组件组合与层级自适应机制能够形成电路相关的布局流程。
AI.conclusion: LLM结合可组合布局组件与经验技能，可作为模拟版图流程的构建者与修订者，实现面向电路特性的权衡调节与层级自适应，在面积与后版图性能上获得收益。该方法把"流程设计"本身纳入优化回路，为模拟布局提供了区别于固定流程与纯数值优化的新范式；其局限在于评测规模有限(两电路、180nm)，可布线与电性能评估为轻量近似。

title: Caerus: Prefetching by Thinking Globally and Acting Locally
comment: Accepted to MICRO 2026
summary:
Modern processors rely heavily on data prefetching to bridge the growing performance gap between computation and memory accesses. In offset prefetching, prefetches are issued at an address delta relative to the most recently observed access, selecting deltas that have exhibited high coverage in the recent access-stream history. The Best-Offset Prefetcher (BOP) exemplifies this approach by selecting a single uniformly-issued global offset that delivers timely prefetches. However, its lack of context-sensitive accuracy tracking results in significantly increased DRAM traffic and sometimes disappointing performance. Conversely, Berti, the state-of-the-art offset prefetcher, achieves impressive prefetching performance and accuracy. However, its Program-Counter (PC)-local approach to extracting offsets limits its ability to capture global memory patterns, meaning there are many scenarios where simpler global offset prefetchers, such as BOP, outperform it.
  Observing the limitations of contemporary offset prefetchers, we present Caerus: an offset prefetcher that employs PC-local filtering on multiple non-overlapping globally derived offsets. Caerus extracts multiple offsets from the global memory trace and maximizes their combined coverage by training each offset only on accesses not already covered by previously learned offsets. The accuracy of each extracted offset is tracked per-PC based on whether it can cover future accesses for any PC. This allows Caerus to address complex delta patterns while maintaining high accuracy. In SPECspeed 2017, Caerus gains a geomean speedup of 8.3%, outperforming Berti by 2.0% while achieving low hardware and DRAM-traffic overhead.

AI.tldr: Caerus 是一种在多个互不重叠的全局偏移上做 PC 局部过滤的偏移预取器，在 SPECspeed 2017 上取得 8.3% 几何平均加速，比 SOTA 的 Berti 高 2.0%，且硬件与 DRAM 流量开销低。
AI.motivation: 计算与访存之间的性能鸿沟使数据预取至关重要。偏移预取中，BOP 选取单一全局偏移、均匀发放，但缺乏上下文敏感的精度跟踪，导致 DRAM 流量显著增加、性能有时不佳；Berti 虽精度与性能出色，但其 PC 局部提取偏移的方式限制了捕捉全局访存模式的能力，在不少场景下反而不如 BOP 这类简单全局偏移预取器。二者各自的局限催生了对兼顾全局模式覆盖与高精度的偏移预取方法的需求。
AI.method: Caerus 从全局访存轨迹中提取多个非重叠偏移，并仅用尚未被先前已学偏移覆盖的访问来训练后续偏移，以最大化这些偏移的联合覆盖率；对每个提取出的偏移，按 PC 逐一跟踪其精度，判断其能否覆盖任意 PC 的未来访问，从而在应对复杂 delta 模式的同时保持高精度。
AI.result: 在 SPECspeed 2017 上，Caerus 取得 8.3% 的几何平均加速，比 Berti 高出 2.0%，同时硬件开销与 DRAM 流量开销均较低。
AI.conclusion: Caerus 将全局偏移提取与 PC 局部精度过滤相结合，弥补了 BOP 精度跟踪不足与 Berti 全局模式覆盖不足的短板，在低开销下实现了优于现有最优偏移预取器的性能。

title: MRUD: Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit Number Systems for High-Performance Arithmetic Units
comment: 22 pages, 15 figures. Submitted to Integration, the VLSI Journal (Elsevier). Under review
summary: Signed digit redundant number systems such as Maximally Redundant Signed Digit (MRSD) enable carry-free addition but introduce significant overhead in multiplication due to the presence of both positive and negative bits. While Unsigned Digit Redundant (UDR) systems have shown promise in radix-2, their extension to higher radices remains unexplored. This work presents the first generalized Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit (MRUD) number systems for high-radix arithmetic, extending UDR representations from radix-2 to radix-$2^h$ while preserving carry-free addition. The proposed framework includes digit encoding, digit extension, arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, and multiplication), sign inversion, forward/reverse conversion algorithms, overflow/underflow detection, and hardware architectures for both signed and unsigned MRUD representations. Unlike MRSD, which is inherently limited to signed arithmetic, MRUD supports both signed and unsigned representations, similar to conventional binary systems. Evaluations across three multiplier modes---RRR (Redundant inputs, Redundant output), BBR (Binary inputs, Redundant output), and BBB (Binary inputs, Binary output)---as well as Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, using the FreePDK 45nm library, demonstrate that MRUD achieves up to 30\% lower delay, 26\% smaller area, and 87\% lower power than MRSD. In BBR mode, MRUD achieves up to 43\% delay reduction over the best conventional architecture for 32$\times$32 operands, while in Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, performing reverse conversion only once at the end yields up to 64\% higher throughput than DesignWare and over 150\% higher than Wallace. These results demonstrate that MRUD enables high-radix redundant arithmetic with significantly improved multiplier and MAC performance, making it an efficient alternative to conventional signed digit redundant number systems.

AI.tldr: 提出首个高基数广义最大冗余无符号数字（MRUD）数制，将UDR从radix-2推广到radix-2^h并保持无进位加法，配套完整算法与硬件架构；在45nm下相比MRSD最多降低30%延迟、26%面积、87%功耗。
AI.motivation: MRSD等有符号冗余数制虽可无进位加法，但因同时存在正负位元导致乘法开销大；UDR在radix-2已有优势但向高基数的推广尚属空白，且冗余数制普遍只支持有符号运算，缺乏类似常规二进制的统一有符号/无符号支持。
AI.method: 构建广义MRUD数制框架：给出数字编码、数字扩展、加/减/乘运算、符号取反、正/反向转换算法、上溢/下溢检测，以及有符号与无符号MRUD的硬件架构；在FreePDK 45nm库下评估RRR、BBR、BBB三种乘法器模式及MAC单元。
AI.result: 相比MRSD，MRUD最多降低30%延迟、26%面积、87%功耗；BBR模式下32×32操作数较最优常规架构延迟降低达43%；MAC单元仅在末尾做一次反向转换，吞吐率较DesignWare高64%、较Wallace高150%以上。
AI.conclusion: MRUD使高基数冗余算术在乘法器与MAC中性能显著提升，可作为有符号数字冗余数制的高效替代方案。

title: RV2GC: Reconstructing the Garbling Boundary in a RISC-V Garbled Processor
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables
summary: Programmable garbled-circuit execution must balance the benefits of cross-program reuse against the cost of repeated work during secure execution. A complete garbled processor provides a fixed circuit for many programs, but its evaluator repeatedly visits processor-wide structures even when only a small part performs the current protected computation. We present RV2GC, which reconstructs the garbling boundary around a fixed library of RISC-V instruction circuits. Public scheduling and operand routing operate outside the circuit topologies; persistent label-encoded state connects independently invoked garbled instruction circuits and instruction-specific garbling-free paths through a common interface. A Conditional-execution Stack and protected commits support secret-dependent branches, bounded loops, and secret-indexed memory access under public scheduling, keeping instruction and memory-address sequences independent of private inputs. Across nine benchmarks, measured ARM2GC-to-RV2GC runtime ratios range from 12.81 to 4,043. In terms of circuit size, the largest listed instruction circuit has 3,386 gates, corresponding to 2.044% and 0.393% of the 256-byte and 4,096-byte Amber processors, respectively. Additional comparisons quantify schedule storage, communication, and the cost of secret-dependent execution.

AI.tldr: RV2GC 将混淆电路的边界重构为围绕固定 RISC-V 指令电路库的指令级按需执行框架，通过公开调度、持久化标签编码状态与条件执行栈，在隐藏私有输入的前提下显著降低安全执行开销。
AI.motivation: 完整混淆处理器虽能为多程序复用固定电路，但评估器在执行局部计算时仍需重复遍历处理器全局结构，造成大量冗余工作；因此需要权衡跨程序复用的收益与重复执行的成本，把混淆边界从"整机"下沉到"指令级"。
AI.method: 提出 RV2GC：围绕固定 RISC-V 指令电路库重构混淆边界；公开的调度与操作数路由置于电路拓扑之外；用持久化的标签编码状态连接独立调用的混淆指令电路与指令专属的免混淆路径，并通过统一接口交互；引入条件执行栈（Conditional-execution Stack）与受保护提交机制，在公开调度下支持秘密相关分支、有界循环与秘密索引访存，使指令序列与内存地址序列独立于私有输入。
AI.result: 在九个基准上，ARM2GC 与 RV2GC 的运行时间比值为 12.81 至 4,043；电路规模上，所列最大指令电路为 3,386 个门，分别相当于 256 字节与 4,096 字节 Amber 处理器的 2.044% 与 0.393%；另量化了调度存储、通信开销及秘密相关执行代价。
AI.conclusion: 将混淆粒度细化到指令级并按需调用，可在保持地址与指令序列不泄露私有输入的同时，大幅优于完整混淆处理器的执行效率；指令级电路规模远小于整机电路，为可编程安全执行提供了更优的开销—复用折中。

title: LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation
comment: 5 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027. Code and data: https://github.com/kadomoto-lab/llm-cpu-fpga-loop
summary: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于FPGA的在环开发环境，让LLM智能体实现CPU候选设计并用板载性能测量指导设计决策，成功将单周期RV32I核演进为三发射乱序RV32IM核，在Artix-7上达130 MHz、5.61 CoreMark/MHz；同候选运行8000次CoreMark迭代时，含实现在内的FPGA评估比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍。
AI.motivation: RTL仿真评估CPU候选设计的成本很高：长时间仿真需数小时，而短诊断运行可能漏掉执行后期才出现的性能退化，从而延误LLM智能体驱动的CPU开发中的设计决策。
AI.method: 构建由LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选并以板载性能测量来指导设计决策的开发环境；在人工监督下，以该流程将单周期RV32I核迭代为三发射乱序RV32IM核，并与单线程RTL仿真进行同候选对比评估。
AI.result: 最终设计在Artix-7 FPGA上于130 MHz达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz；运行8000次CoreMark迭代时，FPGA评估（含实现）比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍；板级测量发现某候选在短诊断中表现更优、但在长时运行中出现性能退化，该结果指导了候选选择并促成基于RTL的根因分析与修复。
AI.conclusion: FPGA在环测量能提供比短诊断运行更可靠、且远快于长时RTL仿真的评估信号，可有效支撑LLM智能体参与的CPU迭代设计，并暴露长时运行中才显现的性能退化问题。

title: APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement
comment: Accepted to ASP-DAC 2027. 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/bingyang1132/applace
summary: Analog layout automation remains challenging in Analog/Mixed-Signal circuit design, because parasitics and mismatches introduced during layout strongly affect circuit performance. Placement is especially critical among the layout stages, as it constrains the routing solution space and the achievable post-layout performance. Existing analytical placement methods optimize device coordinates under center-based wirelength proxies and leave access point (AP) selection to routing. In analog circuits, however, a routing pin is an extended piece of terminal metal rather than a fixed point, and the best AP on it depends on where the other connected devices are placed, so a coordinate-only placement optimizes for connection points that the router will not use. We present APPlace, a routing-aware analog placement framework that co-optimizes device locations and AP selections during global placement, followed by a legalization stage that preserves the structure established by global placement. Experimental results on four real-world analog benchmarks show that APPlace achieves better overall post-layout performance than representative baselines at comparable layout area. Ablation studies further show that removing AP co-optimization causes up to a 13 dB CMRR loss among the OTA benchmarks and a 23% increase in comparator delay.

AI.tldr: APPlace：在全局布局阶段同时优化器件位置与接入点(AP)选择的路由感知模拟布局框架，并配合保持该结构的合法化阶段，在四个真实基准上取得更优的后布局性能。
AI.motivation: 模拟/混合信号布局中寄生与失配强烈影响电路性能，placement 又决定布线解空间与可达的后布局性能；而已有解析式布局方法仅基于中心点线长代理优化器件坐标、把 AP 选择留给布线。模拟电路中布线引脚是一段延伸的终端金属而非固定点，最优 AP 取决于其他相连器件的位置，因此"仅坐标"布局优化的是布线器实际不会使用的连接点。
AI.method: 提出 APPlace 路由感知框架：在全局布局中联合优化器件位置与 AP 选择（AP 与放置协同优化），随后设置合法化阶段，保持全局布局建立的结构不被破坏。
AI.result: 在四个真实模拟基准上，在面积相当情况下，APPlace 的后布局整体性能优于代表性基线；消融实验显示，移除 AP 协同优化导致 OTA 基准 CMRR 最多下降 13 dB，比较器延迟增加 23%。
AI.conclusion: 模拟布局中 AP 选择必须与器件位置联合优化，坐标-only 的布局代理不足；AP 协同优化对关键模拟指标（CMRR、延迟）有显著贡献。

title: Energy-Efficient Memristor Accelerator for Depression Detection with a CNN-LSTM Hybrid Model
summary: Early screening of depression requires efficient analysis of audio and speech data, while conventional CPU and GPU platforms incur high latency and energy consumption for CNN-LSTM inference. To address this challenge, we propose a unified resistive RAM (ReRAM) processing-in-memory accelerator for a CNN-LSTM attention workload. The architecture integrates convolutional, recurrent, attention, and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) stages within a crossbar-based framework, reducing intermediate data movement between spatial and temporal branches. CNN operations are mapped through im2col-based vectorization, while LSTM gate computations are reformulated using concatenated input-state vectors and mapped onto ReRAM crossbars. We further provide module-level workload breakdown, parameter sensitivity analysis, and matched-workload context against representative ReRAM/PIM accelerators. Experimental results show 32.1 times and 9.3 times latency reduction over CPU and GPU baselines, respectively, with about 160 times and 140 times energy reduction. Simplified weight-perturbation tests characterize ASLF sensitivity in an untrained pipeline with synthetic spectrogram-shaped inputs. Task-level prediction accuracy and robustness remain to be evaluated.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向CNN-LSTM-attention抑郁筛查语音分析的统一ReRAM存内计算加速器，将卷积、循环、注意力与MLP阶段集成于交叉阵列框架，减少空域与时间分支间数据搬运；实验相较CPU/GPU实现32.1倍/9.3倍时延降低与约160倍/140倍能耗降低。
AI.motivation: 抑郁早期筛查需高效处理音频与语音数据，而传统CPU与GPU平台运行CNN-LSTM推理存在高时延与高能耗问题，亟需专用加速方案。
AI.method: 采用统一的ReRAM存内计算（PIM）加速器架构，在交叉阵列框架内集成卷积、循环（LSTM）、注意力与MLP各阶段；CNN算子通过im2col向量化映射，LSTM门计算将输入与状态向量拼接后重构成统一矩阵乘并映射到ReRAM交叉阵列；同时给出模块级负载分解、参数敏感性分析及与代表性ReRAM/PIM加速器的同负载对比。
AI.result: 相对CPU和GPU基线分别取得32.1倍和9.3倍时延降低、约160倍和140倍能耗降低；通过简化权重扰动测试，在未训练流水线与合成频谱图形输入下刻画了ASLF的敏感性。任务级预测精度与鲁棒性尚未评估。
AI.conclusion: 统一ReRAM-PIM架构可显著降低CNN-LSTM-attention语音抑郁筛查推理的时延与能耗，验证了跨空域/时间分支融合映射的可行性；但任务级精度与鲁棒性评估留待后续工作。

title: OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, submitted to ISCAS 2027
summary: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. In SKY130, the agent designed a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps (5T, folded-cascode and telescopic OTAs; Miller, folded-cascode and telescopic two-stage) for fun >= 50 MHz, PM >= 60 degrees, SR 25 V/μs into 1 pF and a minimum dc gain of 30 to 60 dB. All six layouts are DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and their extracted netlists meet every target at all 15 PVT corners ( fun >= 53.7 MHz, PM >= 62.1 degrees, SR >= 27.9 V/μs). The benchmark netlists are released at https://github.com/AMPICLab/AMPICBench.

AI.tldr: 提出 OPERA，一个由专家教授的通用 LLM 代理，用开源工具将 CMOS 运放从规格一路设计到后仿签核，在 SKY130 上完成 1 个共源共栅偏置与 6 个运放的全流程并全部达标。
AI.motivation: 模拟电路从规格到签核版图几乎离不开人工迭代；现有 LLM 代理仅在器件尺寸上做优化循环且止步于原理图，未覆盖版图与提取闭环。
AI.method: 两步"专家教学"：先教代理 gm/ID 方法（规格→跨导与最小电流、按器件角色从查表选 gm/ID、由方程定尺寸、只留少量可搜索旋钮以保持可解释性）；再教 gLayout 框架与版图实践经验，由代理编写可复用的版图生成器，在设计师批准的检查点上闭合版图—提取回路。
AI.result: 在 SKY130 中完成 1 个共用恒 gm 偏置与 6 个运放（5T、折叠共源共栅、套筒 OTA；Miller、折叠共源共栅、套筒两级），目标为 fun≥50 MHz、PM≥60°、SR 25 V/μs（1 pF）、直流增益 30–60 dB。六个版图均 DRC 干净、LVS 匹配，提取网表在全部 15 个 PVT 角达标（fun≥53.7 MHz、PM≥62.1°、SR≥27.9 V/μs）。基准网表已开源。
AI.conclusion: 经专家教授的通用 LLM 代理可在开源 EDA 流程中自主完成运放原理图—版图—提取的全链路设计并获得可解释、可复用且对 PVT 鲁棒的成果，展示了代理式模拟设计走向签核的可行性。

title: Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification
summary: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. Wall relaxation searches the chip by pricing the hardware limits that bind the software. This paper takes a first step, through separate studies rather than one end-to-end run. On NVIDIA GB10, templates the agent wrote run complete Qwen3-8B layers $1.075\times$ faster than SGLang. In a simulated Ventus GPU study, joint design cuts the worst-scenario cycles of Qwen2.5-0.5B to 0.428 of the reference, against 0.934 for software alone. On a five-step GEMM refinement chain, reusing proofs makes checking $2.51\times$ faster.

AI.tldr: 提出 Formulaic 流程：由语言模型智能体编写数学形式化（formulation），求解器在其内优化，验证与测量核查假设与结果，从而跨越 AI 基础设施中"芯片与软件需协同改动"的层次边界。
AI.motivation: AI 基础设施（芯片与软件）按层次设计，层次虽使系统可管理，却固定了优化器可考虑的选择空间；需要芯片与软件协同改动的收益在优化开始前就已被排除在形式化之外。语言模型智能体使得重新审视这些边界成为可能，但智能体给出的提案本身无法证明设计正确或最优。
AI.method: 将工作拆分：智能体负责写形式化，数学求解器在形式化内寻优，验证与测量检查其假设与结果。智能体从计算图逐级细化至芯片，每一步是一个模板（一族程序及其正确性条件）；wall relaxation 通过为约束软件的硬件上限定价来搜索芯片设计空间。本文为阶段性工作，以独立研究而非端到端流程呈现。
AI.result: NVIDIA GB10 上，智能体编写的模板运行完整 Qwen3-8B 层比 SGLang 快 1.075×；模拟 Ventus GPU 研究中，联合设计将 Qwen2.5-0.5B 最差场景周期降至参考的 0.428，而仅软件优化为 0.934；五步 GEMM 细化链上复用证明使检查提速 2.51×。
AI.conclusion: 智能体 + 求解器 + 验证/测量的分工可在保持正确性可检验的前提下部分突破层次抽象的限制，联合软硬件设计收益显著优于单独软件优化，但尚需整合为端到端流程。

title: Energy-Efficient FPGA Implementation of an End-to-End Cosine-Domain CNN Using High-Level Synthesis
comment: 9 pages, 11 figures. Currently under review at the VLSI Integration Journal
summary: The computational cost of conventional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) limits their deployment in low-power devices for high-speed edge AI applications. This paper presents an end-to-end cosine-domain CNN (CD-CNN) architecture for energy-efficient FPGA inference using high-level synthesis (HLS). The proposed architecture performs intermediate feature extraction using real-valued DCT-domain representations, avoiding complex-valued arithmetic and intermediate inverse transforms between spectral layers. The design is implemented on a Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA and evaluated against a fully spectral Fourier-domain CNN (FD-CNN) under consistent network and implementation constraints. Experiments on the MNIST and 94-class ASCII datasets show that the CD-CNN reduces normalized resource utilization and improves inference throughput on both datasets. Its energy efficiency reaches 112.91 frames/J for MNIST and 101.27 frames/J for ASCII, corresponding to improvements of $1.51\times$ and $2.76\times$, respectively, over the fully spectral FD-CNN architecture. Furthermore, compared to the previous GPU-based fully spectral CD-CNN implementation, the proposed end-to-end FPGA implementation improves energy efficiency by $12.96\times$. These results demonstrate the potential of real-valued spectral processing in the DCT domain for energy-efficient edge AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端余弦域卷积神经网络（CD-CNN）架构，基于HLS在FPGA上实现高能效推理，在MNIST与94类ASCII数据集上相比全谱傅里叶域CNN（FD-CNN）显著降低资源占用、提升吞吐与能效。
AI.motivation: 传统CNN计算开销大，难以部署于低功耗边缘AI设备；且全谱（复数）傅里叶域CNN存在复数运算与频谱层间逆变换的额外代价。
AI.method: 采用实值DCT域表示完成中间特征提取，避免复数算术与频谱层之间的中间逆变换，构建端到端CD-CNN架构，并用高层次综合（HLS）在Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA上实现；在相同网络与实现约束下与全谱FD-CNN对比，数据集为MNIST与94类ASCII。
AI.result: CD-CNN在MNIST与ASCII上均降低归一化资源占用并提升推理吞吐；能效达112.91 frames/J（MNIST）与101.27 frames/J（ASCII），分别较FD-CNN提升1.51×与2.76×；相比此前的GPU版全谱CD-CNN实现，能效提升12.96×。
AI.conclusion: 实值DCT域频谱处理在能效上优于全谱复数域方案，验证了其在能效边缘AI部署中的潜力。

title: When Does Heterogeneity Pay Off? Understanding GPU-WSE System Complementarity
summary: As AI accelerator architectures become increasingly diverse, integrating different architectures into a unified system is emerging as a new heterogeneous computing paradigm. GPUs and WSEs differ substantially in compute, memory, and communication organization, creating both architectural complementarity and additional overheads, yet how to translate this heterogeneity into practical performance gains remains unclear. To address this gap, we propose a hierarchical benchmarking methodology to characterize GPU--WSE heterogeneous execution and the conditions for exploiting complementarity, together with an analytical performance model that identifies when heterogeneity becomes a bottleneck and when it yields system-level performance gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层基准测试方法与解析性能模型，用于刻画GPU与晶圆级引擎（WSE）异构执行的特征，明确异构互补性可被利用的条件，并判断异构性何时成为瓶颈、何时带来系统级性能增益。
AI.motivation: AI加速器架构日益多样化，将不同架构集成到统一系统成为新的异构计算范式。GPU与WSE在计算、存储、通信组织方式上差异显著，既存在架构互补性也带来额外开销，但如何将这种异构性转化为实际性能增益尚不清晰。
AI.method: 提出分层基准测试方法（hierarchical benchmarking methodology），系统刻画GPU–WSE异构执行过程及互补性的利用条件；并构建解析性能模型（analytical performance model），用于刻画性能边界。
AI.result: 该性能模型能够识别异构性成为瓶颈的情形，以及异构性产生系统级性能增益的情形；分层基准测试可量化GPU–WSE在计算、访存与通信层面的差异与互补空间。
AI.conclusion: 通过基准测试与解析建模相结合，可将GPU–WSE异构性从"架构差异"转化为可判定的性能增益条件，为异构AI加速系统的设计与任务划分提供依据。

title: Tactus: Tactile & Pose Sensing Glove for Natural Dexterity Data Collection
comment: 9 pages
summary: Collecting naturalistic human manipulation demonstrations with accurate contact force and hand pose is essential for robot dexterous manipulation policy and foundational world model learning - yet no existing wearable platform provides both calibrated fingertip force sensing and occlusion-resilient hand tracking in a form factor that preserves natural manipulation behavior. We present Tactus, a textile-integrated sensing glove that co-optimizes three design pillars: (1) a thin, conformal 3D-knit form factor (1.5 mm fingertip stackup) designed to minimize interference with natural manipulation, (2) strategically placed capacitive tactile sensors at manipulation-relevant regions informed by empirical contact studies, and (3) IMU-fused pose tracking that maintains accuracy through the hand-object occlusions where manipulation data is most valuable. Tactus includes a documented calibration pipeline for cross-glove consistency and per-session calibration for subject-dependent correction. To enable objective comparison, we introduce standardized benchmarking protocols for tactile force regression and hand pose estimation, and apply them to Tactus and two commercially available tactile gloves - to our knowledge the first quantitative cross-platform evaluation of this kind. Tactus resolves a minimum detectable force of 0.59 N at 95% confidence, 1.6 - 2.7x lower than the commercial baselines, and with 0.87 cross-participant consistency, while our pose tracking sustains 11.0 mm fingertip keypoint relative error during manipulation, when occlusion is heaviest. We show that these combined signals support object property estimation, slip detection, and representative recording of hand-object interaction - yielding demonstration data with the fidelity required for contact-aware manipulation policies and world models.

AI.tldr: 提出织物集成传感手套 Tactus，兼顾指尖力标定与抗遮挡手部追踪，并首次建立量化跨平台基准，最小可检测力 0.59 N，遮挡下指尖关键点误差 11.0 mm。
AI.motivation: 机器人灵巧操作策略与基础世界模型需要带精确接触力与手部位姿的自然人类操作演示数据，但现有可穿戴平台无法同时提供标定后的指尖力感知与抗遮挡手部追踪，且难以保持自然操作行为。
AI.method: Tactus 围绕三个设计支柱联合优化：(1) 薄型共形3D编织形态（指尖叠层1.5 mm）以减小对自然操作的干扰；(2) 依据实证接触研究在操作相关区域布置电容式触觉传感器；(3) IMU 融合的位姿追踪，在手-物遮挡严重时维持精度。配套跨手套一致性标定流程与逐会话受试者校正；并建立触觉力回归与手部位姿估计的标准化基准协议，对 Tactus 与两款商用触觉手套进行对比。
AI.result: 95% 置信度下最小可检测力 0.59 N，比商用基线低 1.6–2.7 倍；跨被试一致性 0.87；遮挡最严重时指尖关键点相对误差 11.0 mm。融合信号可支撑物体属性估计、滑移检测与手-物交互记录。
AI.conclusion: Tactus 首次实现触觉手套的量化跨平台评测，证明其演示数据保真度足以支撑接触感知的操作策略与世界模型学习。

title: IMPACT: Constraint-Aware Search for Imperfectly Factorized Accelerator Mappings
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in ASP-DAC 2027
summary: The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware. A mapping specifies how the computation is tiled across the memory hierarchy, ordered, and parallelized across the processing elements. These choices form a combinatorially large search space, where efficient mappings are hard to find. Most violate hardware constraints, and most remaining mappings underutilize the hardware. Existing mappers either search only part of this space to keep the search tractable, excluding the most efficient mappings, or sample the full space randomly, so most mappings they evaluate are infeasible. We present IMPACT, a mapper that searches the full space. IMPACT pairs a genetic algorithm with a constraint-aware repair operator that converts each infeasible mapping into a feasible one instead of discarding it. On a flexible accelerator, IMPACT outperforms state-of-the-art mappers in EDP, latency, and energy on every DeepBench workload. On a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator, whose constraints leave few mappings feasible, it reduces EDP by 66%, latency by 47%, and energy by 18% over the strongest prior mapper across five networks, and rivals hand-crafted expert mappings. Across flexible and highly constrained accelerators, IMPACT finds efficient mappings automatically. IMPACT will be released as open source.

AI.tldr: IMPACT 是一种在完整映射空间上搜索的 DNN 加速器映射器，通过遗传算法结合约束感知修复算子，将不可行映射转化为可行映射而非丢弃，在灵活架构与强约束的存算一体加速器上均优于现有映射器。
AI.motivation: 张量算子在硬件上的映射（分块、排序、并行化）构成组合爆炸的搜索空间；多数映射违反硬件约束，其余多数又利用率低。现有映射器要么为可解只搜索部分空间，遗漏最优映射；要么全空间随机采样，评估的映射大多不可行。
AI.method: 提出 IMPACT 映射器，在完整空间搜索：将遗传算法与约束感知的修复算子（constraint-aware repair operator）结合，把每个不可行映射修复为可行映射，而不是直接丢弃。
AI.result: 在灵活加速器上，IMPACT 在全部 DeepBench 工作负载的 EDP、延迟和能耗三项指标上均优于 SOTA 映射器；在可行映射极少的 CIM 加速器上，相对最强基线在五个网络上 EDP 降低 66%、延迟降低 47%、能耗降低 18%，并可媲美手工专家映射。
AI.conclusion: IMPACT 能在灵活与高度受限的加速器上自动找到高效映射，并将开源发布。

title: Hardwired Distributed Processing Units at the Sensor: Truly Parallel Vision Pre-Processing that Frees the Host CPU
comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Companion to arXiv:2610.33107
summary: Conventional vision pipelines route every pixel to a host processor, which must then wait for a complete frame before it can act and devote part of each frame period to routine pre-processing. We examine an alternative organisation in which this work is distributed across hardwired distributed processing units (HDPUs): small, fixed datapaths attached directly to the sensor, each committed to a single always-on task, operating truly in parallel on the same pixel stream and delivering compact results to the host. From one library of 3x3 operators sharing a common two-clock latency, we construct three HDPUs (Canny edges, Harris corners, and a line tracker that issues a steering decision) and run them side by side on a single camera stream in a low-cost Artix-7 FPGA, at a cost of 2,568 LUTs and an estimated 0.318 W. Every stage of every unit is bit-exact with its software model. In a full-system simulation with a datasheet camera model, each decision leaves its HDPU within 11.03 camera lines of the pixel that produced it, 22-67x sooner than the earliest moment at which a frame-based program on the host could respond; the HDPU latency varies by no more than 17 ns, whereas the host's own run times reached 12.5x their median. Offloading the three tasks returns 18-30% of a core to the host in every frame period at 640x480, and 63% of the frame period, with all threads in use, at 1080p. The cost of the units grows with frame width only through their line buffers, and in a closed-loop model of a line-following vehicle the HDPU raises the highest speed at which the line is held from 4.75 to 10.00 m/s.

AI.tldr: 论文提出将视觉预处理任务下沉到紧贴传感器的硬连线分布式处理单元（HDPU），在Artix-7 FPGA上用2568个LUT、约0.318 W搭建Canny边缘、Harris角点与线条跟踪三个HDPU并行处理同一像素流，实现逐比特精确、低且稳定的延迟，并显著释放主机算力。
AI.motivation: 传统视觉流水线把每个像素都送到主机处理器，主机必须等待整帧完成后才能动作，且每帧周期需耗费部分时间做常规预处理，导致响应延迟大、抖动明显、算力被占用。作者希望探索将这些工作分散到与传感器直接相连的专用小型硬连线数据通路的替代组织方式。
AI.method: 构建小型固定数据通路HDPU直接挂接传感器，每个单元始终在线、只执行单一任务，并在同一像素流上真正并行工作、向主机输出紧凑结果。基于一个共享两时钟延迟的3×3算子库，构造三个HDPU（Canny边缘、Harris角点、带转向决策的线条跟踪器），在低成本Artix-7 FPGA上并排运行于单路摄像头流，并与软件模型及数据手册相机模型进行全系统仿真。
AI.result: 资源代价为2568个LUT、估计功耗0.318 W；各单元各级与软件模型逐比特一致。全系统仿真中，每个决策在其产生像素后11.03条相机行内输出，比主机帧式程序最早可能响应时刻快22–67倍；HDPU延迟波动不超过17 ns，而主机运行时间可达中位数的12.5倍。卸载三任务在640×480下每帧归还主机18–30%的核心时间，1080p全线程使用时达帧周期的63%。单元成本仅通过行缓冲随帧宽增长；在线跟随车辆闭环模型中，最高可保持速度由4.75提升至10.00 m/s。
AI.conclusion: 将常规视觉预处理以细粒度、始终在线的硬连线单元形式分布式地置于传感器端，可在极低资源与功耗代价下获得逐比特精确、低抖动且远快于帧式主机的响应，并释放主机算力、提升闭环控制性能；其成本随帧宽仅由行缓冲线性增长，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Streaming Speech Recognition on a Microcontroller: a 65.7M-Parameter Transducer in 2 and 4 Bits on the ESP32-P4
comment: 18 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables, 1 algorithm. Code: https://github.com/BoumedineBillal/esp32-pie-asr ; weights: https://huggingface.co/BoumedineBillal/esp32-pie-asr-kroko-en
summary: We run Kroko, a 65.7M-parameter streaming Zipformer2 transducer for English, on the ESP32-P4, a microcontroller with two 400 MHz RISC-V cores, a 128-bit SIMD extension (PIE) and 32 MB of PSRAM, but no neural accelerator. Without any training, the encoder's 290 matrices are stored with 2 or 4 bits per weight in Hadamard-rotated groups: the width of each matrix comes from its measured sensitivity, and each matrix is first corrected toward the original model's output, then rounded with GPTQ and a search over the group norms. The released 71 MB of int8 weights become a 26.65 MB file. Activations are int16 between the matrix products and int8 into them. A C engine with hand-written PIE kernels processes each 1.28 s chunk of audio in 0.90 s on both cores, beam search included, and its PC build computes the same bits as the chip, so accuracy is measured on whole test sets. LibriSpeech WER is 4.34% on test-clean and 10.26% on test-other, against 3.94% and 9.17% for the released model; on FLEURS and Common Voice the gap grows to 2.3 and 1.1 points. A GPU simulator shows that the integer arithmetic costs nothing and that the whole gap comes from the weights, and an ablation on all of test-clean shows that GPTQ does most of the work. We also report the port's speed history, from 51.3 s to 0.62 s of encoder time per chunk, each design step measured again in one build, an attempt to reach 16 MB that stopped at 19.63 MB, and what did not work. We did not measure energy. The inference engine, the firmware and the 2/4-bit weights are available at https://github.com/BoumedineBillal/esp32-pie-asr.

AI.tldr: 作者将65.7M参数的流式Zipformer2 transducer（Kroko）在无NPU的ESP32-P4（双400MHz RISC-V核、128-bit PIE SIMD、32MB PSRAM）上实现：编码器290个矩阵按敏感度分配2/4-bit并做Hadamard旋转分组量化，权重从71MB int8压缩至26.65MB；C引擎单核双核分配下单chunk（1.28s音频）耗时0.90s（含beam search），LibriSpeech test-clean/test-other WER为4.34%/10.26%。
AI.motivation: 在无神经网络加速器的MCU上部署流式端到端ASR，需要在极受限的算力（8亿次级别/秒的两核）与内存（32MB PSRAM）下同时保证实时性与识别精度，而现有量化/推理方案多面向GPU或带NPU的边缘设备，缺乏对纯RISC-V+SIMD微控制器的完整工程证据与误差归因。
AI.method: 1) 免训练后量化：编码器290个矩阵以2或4 bit/权重存储，按实测敏感度决定逐矩阵位宽；矩阵先做Hadamard旋转分组，再以GPTQ并配合分组scale（norm）搜索进行舍入，并先向原模型输出做校正。2) 激活：矩阵乘法前int8、乘积间int16。3) 手写PIE SIMD内核的C推理引擎，PC版本与芯片逐比特一致，便于在完整测试集上测精度。4) GPU模拟器拆分整型算术与权重量化各自的误差贡献；在全部test-clean上做消融验证GPTQ的作用。
AI.result: 权重文件由71MB int8降至26.65MB；每1.28s音频chunk耗0.90s（双核，含beam search）。WER：LibriSpeech test-clean 4.34%、test-other 10.26%（原模型3.94%/9.17%）；FLEURS与Common Voice差距扩大到2.3和1.1个百分点。GPU模拟器表明整型算术几乎无损失，全部精度差距来自权重量化；消融显示GPTQ贡献最大。工程方面给出从51.3s到0.62s（每chunk编码器时间）的优化历程、向16MB压缩的尝试（止于19.63MB）及失败方案；未测能耗。
AI.conclusion: 在无NPU的RISC-V MCU上可实现流式Zipformer2 transducer的准实时（0.90s/chunk）推理，2/4-bit混合精度加GPTQ在26.65MB内保持了可用的识别精度，误差主要源于权重量化而非整型运算；该工作提供了可复现的引擎、固件与权重，并诚实报告了未达成的压缩目标与失败尝试。

title: Exploring and optimizing the Vivado Flow on large FPGA designs: A Practical Analysis of Strategies and Their Impact on Timing
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications. The Vivado Design Suite offers several strategies for optimization, but finding the best configuration for a given project remains challenging. This paper explores the various Vivado's timing directives and strategies to improve performance across timing, area, and runtime. Through two test-case designs, an NQR spectrometer SoC-FPGA and a digital readout ASIC prototype for high energy physics particle detector's, different strategies and configurations are compared to identify the most efficient flow.

AI.tldr: 本文比较Vivado的多种时序指令与实现策略，在NQR谱仪SoC-FPGA与高能物理探测器数字读出ASIC原型两个测试设计上分别评估时序、面积与运行时表现，以筛选最高效的流程配置。
AI.motivation: FPGA设计中的时序收敛对高性能应用至关重要；Vivado虽提供多种优化策略，但为具体项目选出最优配置仍具挑战性，缺乏面向实际设计的策略对比指导。
AI.method: 梳理Vivado的时序驱动directives与implementation strategies，在两个测试用例设计（NQR谱仪SoC-FPGA、高能物理粒子探测器数字读出ASIC原型）上运行不同策略与配置组合，并从时序、面积、运行时间三个维度进行对比分析。
AI.result: 论文给出了不同策略/配置在两个设计上的对比结果，用于识别在时序、面积与运行时之间权衡最优的流程（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
AI.conclusion: 通过实际设计案例的策略对比可有效定位更高效的Vivado实现流程，为类似SoC-FPGA与读出原型设计的时序收敛配置选择提供实践参考。

title: GI-RTL-Fuzz: Grammar-Informed RTL Generation with LLMs for End-to-End Differential Simulator Fuzzing
summary: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulators are fundamental to modern IC design workflows, yet like any complex software, they frequently contain critical bugs that compromise simulation accuracy. To systematically stress-test these tools, we introduce GI-RTL-Fuzz, a grammar-informed fuzzing framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate high-quality RTL test cases. Our key innovation is guiding the LLM's generation process using Backus-Naur Form (BNF) grammar coverage information, enabling the exploration of complex and rarely-tested language features. By performing differential testing against different RTL simulators, our framework uncovered a significant number of previously unknown inconsistencies in both the linting process and simulation results of major Verilog simulators.

AI.tldr: GI-RTL-Fuzz用BNF文法覆盖率引导LLM生成RTL测试用例，并以差分测试方式在主流的Verilog仿真器中发现大量未知的lint与仿真结果不一致。
AI.motivation: RTL仿真器是现代IC设计流程的基础工具，但与其他复杂软件一样，其中存在可能影响仿真正确性的关键缺陷。为系统性地对这些工具进行压力测试，需要高质量的RTL测试用例来充分覆盖复杂的语言特性。
AI.method: 提出GI-RTL-Fuzz，一种语法引导（grammar-informed）的模糊测试框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）生成高质量RTL测试用例。其核心创新在于使用巴科斯-诺尔范式（BNF）文法覆盖率信息来引导LLM的生成过程，从而探索复杂且鲜少被测试的语言特性；并通过差分测试（differential testing）比较不同RTL仿真器的行为。
AI.result: 在主流的Verilog仿真器间进行差分测试，在lint流程与仿真结果两方面均发现了大量此前未知的不一致（inconsistencies）。
AI.conclusion: 将BNF文法覆盖率信息引入LLM驱动的测试用例生成，是一种可行的RTL仿真器压力测试手段，能够有效暴露主流Verilog仿真器中隐藏的缺陷与行为不一致。

title: The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators
summary: Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. This raises a practical question: if a model can draw the layout itself, what does a generator framework still contribute, and is applying these models to a generator framework better than having them draw a layout from scratch? Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, we find that the main obstacle to drawing a layout directly is its time and token cost, and that the main advantage of a model building on a generator framework is reusability. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit to be evaluated across an entire family of layouts. Accordingly, a model is most effective when it develops the layout from the generator source of the family that the design intent belongs to, and tests each edit on the family members most likely to fail, so that one verified change improves every layout the generator produces. The results of these family tests can then serve as supervision for a local model, which learns edits that hold across the family at a fraction of the inference cost.

AI.tldr: 在SKY130上对gLayout的受控实验表明，直接用LLM绘制版图的主要瓶颈是时间与token成本，而基于生成器框架的核心优势是可复用性：已验证的原语使每次模型编辑足够小、可检查，参数化使单次编辑可在一族版图上评估。因此最有效的方式是让模型针对设计意图所属族群的生成器源码进行开发，并在最可能失败的族成员上测试每次编辑；族测试结果还可作为监督信号训练本地模型，以更低推理成本习得跨族有效的编辑。
AI.motivation: 模拟版图设计仍以手工为主、难以自动化。gLayout等生成器框架将版图表达为程序，可从参数化、设计规则感知的生成器产生版图，但编写生成器仍需专家投入。前沿大语言模型已能编写生成器代码，甚至能依据设计意图直接绘制版图几何。由此引出实际问题：若模型能自行绘制版图，生成器框架还有何贡献？将模型用于生成器框架是否优于从零直接绘制版图？论文旨在通过受控实验回答这一问题。
AI.method: 在SKY130工艺下对gLayout开展受控实验，对比“模型直接绘制版图”与“模型在生成器框架上开发”两条路径。并据此提出工作流：让模型基于设计意图所属族群的生成器源码进行迭代开发；每次编辑时选择最可能失败的族成员进行测试；将族测试结果作为监督数据，用于微调/蒸馏本地模型，使其以更低的推理成本学习跨族通用的编辑。
AI.result: 直接绘制版图的主要障碍是时间与token开销；生成器框架带来的主要优势是可复用性——已验证原语保证每次编辑规模小、便于检查，参数化使一次编辑可在整个版图族上评估。采用“按族开发、对最易失败成员测试”的策略时，一次经验证的改动即可改进该生成器产出的所有版图；族测试结果作为监督训练本地模型后，本地模型能以推理成本的一小部分学到在整族上成立的编辑。
AI.conclusion: 生成器框架的价值不在于替代模型的绘图能力，而在于提供可复用的验证与参数化抽象，使LLM编辑更可控、可泛化。模型与生成器框架结合优于从零绘制版图；合理的族级开发与测试流程，加上用族测试结果监督本地小模型，可显著提升效率并降低推理成本。

title: A Case Study of a Multi-Agent Kernel-Optimization Loop That Learns a New AI Accelerator
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Round 1 of the NPU Model Optimization Competition at MICRO 2026. Code: https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop
summary: Frontier large language models write correct CUDA kernels for most single-operator benchmark tasks, yet their accuracy collapses on accelerators whose architecture and programming language they have rarely seen. We present a case study of an LLM agent loop built for such accelerators. Our example is the FuriosaAI RNGD NPU, programmed in a recent, sparsely documented Rust DSL, where the loop optimized three Gemma-4-12B decode kernels over 12 days on a shared, scarce device. The loop builds its own target knowledge: it writes and checks a summary of the DSL documentation, measures the chip with microbenchmarks, records compiler-derived legality rules, and revisits this knowledge when the toolchain changes, rechecking rules and measurements where it can. A role-based search over per-kernel Design Trees explores whole-kernel designs and accumulates small accepted changes in the best version of each kernel. Because device time is scarce and readings are noisy, cheap checks screen new designs before any device run, and late in the run a change was accepted only after repeated comparisons with the best kernel on the device. The final kernels reach a 9.293x geomean speedup over the official baseline, each within 1.25x of the cycles needed just to move its weights. Our prompts, profiler and acceptance test are available at https://github.com/bgchun-fs/multi-agent-kernel-gen-loop.

AI.tldr: 本文以FuriosaAI RNGD NPU（Rust DSL）为对象，构建LLM智能体循环，在12天内对3个Gemma-4-12B解码kernel进行优化，最终相比官方基线取得9.293倍几何平均加速，每个kernel耗时均在"仅搬运权重所需周期"的1.25倍以内。
AI.motivation: 前沿LLM能写出正确的CUDA kernel，但对架构和编程语言少见的加速器（如稀疏文档的新Rust DSL）准确率骤降；同时设备稀缺、读数有噪声，需要一种能在陌生硬件上自建知识并高效利用有限设备时间的智能体优化方法。
AI.method: 1) 自建目标知识：编写并校验DSL文档摘要、用微基准测量芯片、记录编译器推导的合法性规则，并在工具链变更时复查规则与测量；2) 基于角色的搜索遍历每个kernel的设计树（Design Tree），既探索整kernel设计，也累积小步被接受的改动；3) 廉价检查作为设备运行前的筛选，运行后期仅在设备上多次与最佳kernel对比后才接受改动。
AI.result: 最终kernel相对官方基线达到9.293倍几何平均加速，且每个kernel的周期数都在其权重搬运所需周期的1.25倍以内（接近内存带宽下界）。提示词、profiler与验收测试已开源。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体循环可通过自建并维护目标知识、结合设计树搜索与噪声鲁棒的廉价筛选/设备复验机制，在文档稀疏、设备稀缺的新加速器上实现接近带宽上限的kernel优化；论文公开了提示词、profiler与验收测试以支持复现。

title: Rosemary: Efficient and Adaptable In-Storage Acceleration for Fully Homomorphic Encryption
summary: Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computation on encrypted data and is promising for privacy-preserving computing. However, FHE deployment remains constrained due to massive computational, memory, and data-movement overheads. Existing acceleration strategies often overlook the storage I/O bottleneck caused by the enormous size of FHE data in large-scale applications, as most prior works focus on small benchmarks that fit in main memory. Our studies show that state-of-the-art FHE systems spend 71\% to 85\% of their execution time moving data between storage and compute units rather than performing useful computation. To address the I/O bottleneck, we present Rosemary, a heterogeneous FHE acceleration system that incorporates a novel in-storage processing (ISP) architecture with compiler-level and algorithmic optimizations. Our key innovations include 1) an adaptable hardware-aware FHE engine inside a NAND flash-based solid-state drive (SSD) for efficient and cost-effective in-storage FHE processing, 2) a Throughput-Data-Aware Program Allocator (TDAP) that partitions FHE workloads into heterogeneous programs, and 3) a Compiler-Level Ciphertext-Aware Optimizer (CLCAO) that exploits ISP-friendly FHE kernels for low-cost ISP execution. Across a diverse set of FHE workloads, including encrypted deep learning inference and cloud database queries, Rosemary achieves geometric-mean speedups of $185.7\times$ over state-of-the-art CPU/GPU implementations and $3.7\times$ over prior FHE accelerators, while improving energy efficiency by up to $3.9\times$ and Energy-Delay-Area-Product (EDAP) by up to $16.5\times$.

AI.tldr: Rosemary 是一个面向全同态加密（FHE）的异构加速系统，通过在 NAND 闪存 SSD 内集成存储内计算（ISP）硬件引擎，并结合编译器与算法层优化，突破 FHE 应用中的存储 I/O 瓶颈。
AI.motivation: FHE 虽可支持密文计算以保护隐私，但其计算、内存与数据搬移开销巨大。现有加速工作多基于可全部装进主存的小规模基准，忽视了大规模 FHE 应用中数据体量巨大所导致的存储 I/O 瓶颈。作者实测发现，先进 FHE 系统有 71%–85% 的执行时间用于在存储与计算单元之间搬运数据，而非有效计算。
AI.method: 提出异构 FHE 加速系统 Rosemary，包含三项核心创新：1）在基于 NAND 闪存的 SSD 内部嵌入可适配、硬件感知的 FHE 计算引擎，实现高效且高性价比的存储内 FHE 处理；2）设计吞吐-数据感知的程序分配器（TDAP），将 FHE 负载切分并调度到异构程序上；3）设计编译器级密文感知优化器（CLCAO），利用对 ISP 友好的 FHE 内核实现低成本存储内执行。
AI.result: 在包括加密深度学习的推理与云数据库查询等多样化 FHE 负载上，Rosemary 相对最先进的 CPU/GPU 实现取得 185.7× 的几何平均加速，相对已有 FHE 加速器取得 3.7× 加速；能效最高提升 3.9×，EDAP（能耗-延迟-面积积）最高改善 16.5×。
AI.conclusion: 存储 I/O 是大规模 FHE 部署的关键瓶颈，将 FHE 计算下沉到存储设备并配合跨层（硬件-编译器-调度）协同优化，可显著提升性能、能效与面积效率，为隐私计算场景下的 FHE 实用化提供可行路径。

title: FPGAFly: A 166.7k-Neuron Fruit-Fly Connectome on One FPGA via Deferred Spike Expansion and Shared-Codeword States
summary: Synapse-resolution fruit-fly (Drosophila) connectomes enable neuron-by-neuron simulation of entire insect nervous systems, yet whole-brain models still require computationally demanding software or multiple neuromorphic chips, and single FPGAs support only small or statistical networks. Scaling to the full connectome, per-synapse spike expansion scales queue traffic with fan-out up to 11.2k, while 41-bit neuron states require 6.83 Mbit, exceeding the 6.27 Mbit on-chip block static RAM (BSRAM) of the target device. FPGAFly runs the 166.7k-neuron, 25.6M-connection leaky integrate-and-fire male central nervous system (CNS) connectome on one FPGA. Order-preserving deferred expansion queues one 64-bit descriptor per spike in source-ID order, cutting external memory traffic by 54.5%-57.9% and peak queue data by 95.6%-96.5% with bit-identical results. A 24-bit encoding shares codewords across normal, refractory, and quantized out-of-range states, reducing BSRAM usage from 438 to 270 with 1245 extra LUTs and zero changes across 10,000 MNIST predictions. At 80 MHz on a Gowin GW5AST-LV138, each 100 ms window finishes in 86.83 ms on average and within 93.05 ms across 2000 tests, realizing the first complete Drosophila CNS connectome simulation on one FPGA.

AI.tldr: FPGAFly 在单块 FPGA（Gowin GW5AST-LV138）上实现了果蝇雄性中枢神经系统 16.67 万神经元、2560 万突触连接的完整连接组实时仿真，为单芯片全脑建模提供可行方案。
AI.motivation: 突触分辨率的果蝇连接组使逐神经元仿真成为可能，但全脑模型依赖昂贵软件或多块神经形态芯片，单块 FPGA 仅能承载小规模或统计性网络。直接扩展面临两大瓶颈：逐突触脉冲展开使队列流量随扇出（最高 11.2k）放大；41 位神经元状态需 6.83 Mbit，超过目标器件 6.27 Mbit 的片上 BSRAM。
AI.method: 1）保持顺序的延迟展开队列：按源 ID 顺序为每个脉冲存储单个 64 位描述符，抑制扇出导致的流量膨胀；2）24 位状态编码：正常态、不应期态与量化越界态共享码字，压缩存储开销。
AI.result: 外部存储器流量降低 54.5%–57.9%，队列峰值数据量降低 95.6%–96.5%，且结果位级一致；BSRAM 占用由 438 降至 270，仅增加 1245 个 LUT，10,000 次 MNIST 预测输出零差异。在 80 MHz 下，每 100 ms 仿真窗口平均耗时 86.83 ms，2000 次测试中最坏 93.05 ms。
AI.conclusion: 通过算法-架构协同优化，首次在单块 FPGA 上完成完整果蝇中枢神经系统连接组的实时仿真，验证了单芯片全脑规模脉冲网络仿真的可行性。

title: SPARSEBLEED: Bypassing Attribute-Inference Defenses via Sparsity Optimizations
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are widely deployed in safety- and privacy-critical domains such as healthcare and finance, where models are trained on confidential data. This paper presents the first hardware-level attribute-stealing attack that bypasses state-of-the-art privacy defenses, revealing that accelerator optimizations intended for performance can directly undermine data confidentiality. SparseBleed requires no access to gradients, logits, model weights, ground-truth labels, power traces, DVFS manipulation, shared caches, or other channels. Instead, we show that sparsity-driven execution paths encode stable timing signatures that act as a surrogate for model confidence, enabling high-fidelity attribute inference from a single query. SparseBleed generalizes across heterogeneous backends and hardware engines, including Intel AVX2/AVX-512/AMX, NVIDIA Ampere Tensor Cores with 2:4 sparsity, and nine well-known sparse and dense libraries such as Intel oneDNN, oneMKL SparseBLAS, and NVIDIA cuSPARSE. We evaluate SparseBleed to infer sensitive input attributes and true output labels. On Texas-100X, SparseBleed infers sensitive input attributes such as Sex with 66.39% accuracy and recovers the true output label, Surgical Procedure, with 99.8% accuracy. Finally, we evaluate mitigations. Constant-time execution by disabling sparsity optimizations is expensive (e.g., up to $2\times$ higher latency on NVIDIA Sparse Tensor Cores and $\approx 25\%$ higher power in AMX microbenchmarks). By contrast, a padding defense that equalizes responses to the worst-case time masks timing leakage with only 7.24% average performance overhead across nine libraries on Texas-100X/Adult and near-zero extra energy.

AI.tldr: SparseBleed 是首个绕过现有隐私防御的硬件级属性窃取攻击：无需梯度、logits、权重、标签、功耗轨迹等任何通道，仅利用稀疏化执行路径产生的稳定时序签名作为模型置信度的替代信号，单次查询即可高保真地推断敏感输入属性与真实输出标签。
AI.motivation: DNN 广泛部署于医疗、金融等安全与隐私敏感领域，模型在机密数据上训练；已有工作关注软件层面的隐私攻击与防御，但忽视了面向性能的加速器优化（如稀疏化执行）本身可能直接破坏数据机密性，且现有最先进隐私防御并不能阻挡硬件层面的泄露。
AI.method: 提出 SparseBleed 时序侧信道攻击：利用稀疏驱动的执行路径所编码的稳定时序签名，将其作为模型置信度的替身信号，从而在单次查询下完成属性推断。攻击不依赖梯度、logits、模型权重、真值标签、功耗轨迹、DVFS 操纵、共享缓存等通道。方法在异构后端与硬件引擎上通用，包括 Intel AVX2/AVX-512/AMX、带 2:4 稀疏的 NVIDIA Ampere Tensor Cores，以及 Intel oneDNN、oneMKL SparseBLAS、NVIDIA cuSPARSE 等九种稀疏/稠密库。并评估了两种缓解措施：禁用稀疏优化的常时执行，以及等化最坏情况响应时间的填充防御。
AI.result: 在 Texas-100X 数据集上，SparseBleed 推断敏感输入属性（如 Sex）准确率达 66.39%，恢复真实输出标签 Surgical Procedure 的准确率达 99.8%，并在多种后端与库上泛化。缓解评估：禁用稀疏优化的常时执行代价高昂（NVIDIA 稀疏 Tensor Core 延迟最高增加 2×，AMX 微基准功耗增加约 25%）；而填充防御在 Texas-100X/Adult 上跨九个库平均仅带来 7.24% 性能开销，额外能耗近乎为零，即可掩盖时序泄露。
AI.conclusion: 面向性能的稀疏加速器优化会直接削弱数据机密性，构成被现有隐私防御忽视的硬件级属性窃取风险；该攻击跨后端、跨库普遍存在。相比之下，常时执行代价过高，而时间填充防御以极低开销（平均 7.24% 性能损失、近乎零额外能耗）即可有效抑制时序泄露，是更实用的缓解方案。

title: SLICE-CiM: Selective Layer-wise Inference Control Engine with Confidence-Based Early Exit for SRAM based Digital Compute-in-Memory
summary: Digital SRAM compute-in-memory (CIM) macros enable energy-efficient CNN inference by eliminating off-chip weight transfers; however, peripheral control logic introduces three inefficiencies: bit- slice over-activation at reduced precision (L1), unnecessary accumula- tion depth (L2), and idle precision-transition stalls (L3). To address these, we present four synthesizable peripheral blocks: a Flush-Merge Enable (FME) controller, a Confidence-Based Early-Exit (EE) module, a Precision Register with Decoder (PR/PD), and a Bit-Serial Cycle Controller (CC), co-designed to minimize switching activity, wordline overhead, and leakage. Implemented in TSMC 65-nm CMOS at 335 MHz, the peripheral framework occupies 1769.760 μm2 post-synthesis and 1982.131 μm2 post-PnR. Gate-level VCD analysis reports 6.0706 μW leakage and 288.2902 μW (post-synthesis) / 322.8850 μW (post-PnR) dynamic power, totaling 328.9556 μW (0.2402% of system power). The EE module dominates dynamic power (58.2%), while WLG dominates area (58.1%). System evaluation on MobileNetV2 (CIFAR-100) shows efficiency scaling from 31.35 TOPS/W (8b/8b, 1.2 V) to 454.91 TOPS/W (2b/8b, 0.8 V), achieving 13.33x improvement without bitcell modification or retraining. The framework targets CNN workloads exploiting sparsity, with Transformer extension as future work.

AI.tldr: 提出四个可综合的SRAM存内计算（CIM）外围控制模块（FME控制器、置信度早退出EE模块、精度寄存器/译码器PR/PD、位串行周期控制器CC），消除低精度下的位切片过激活、冗余累加深度和精度切换停顿三类开销，在TSMC 65nm下外围仅占系统功耗0.2402%，MobileNetV2上能效从31.35提升至454.91 TOPS/W（13.33×），无需改动位单元或重训练。
AI.motivation: 数字SRAM CIM宏虽免去片外权重传输，但外围控制逻辑存在三类低效：L1 降精度时位切片被过度激活；L2 累加深度超出实际需要；L3 精度切换期间流水停顿。目标是仅通过外围控制协同设计降低开关活动、字线开销与漏电。
AI.method: 设计四个可综合外围模块并协同优化：(1) Flush-Merge Enable (FME) 控制器合并/冲刷累加，减少冗余累加深度；(2) Confidence-Based Early-Exit (EE) 模块按置信度提前终止计算；(3) Precision Register with Decoder (PR/PD) 管理精度切换；(4) Bit-Serial Cycle Controller (CC) 抑制未使用位切片的激活。TSMC 65nm CMOS实现，335 MHz，综合后/PnR后面积分别为1769.760 μm²和1982.131 μm²，并进行门级VCD功耗分析与MobileNetV2(CIFAR-100)系统评估。
AI.result: 功耗：漏电6.0706 μW，动态288.2902 μW（综合后）/322.8850 μW（PnR后），合计328.9556 μW，占系统功耗0.2402%。EE模块占动态功耗58.2%，WLG占面积58.1%。能效由8b/8b、1.2 V的31.35 TOPS/W提升至2b/8b、0.8 V的454.91 TOPS/W，实现13.33×提升，且无需修改位单元或重训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过四个可综合外围控制模块的协同设计，可在不改动位单元与不重训练的前提下显著提升数字SRAM CIM的能效，外围开销极低（占系统功耗0.24%），适用于利用稀疏性的CNN负载；Transformer扩展为未来工作。

title: Keeping Inference in the Radio: Design and Measurement of a Spiking Accelerator for mmWave ISAC Activity Recognition
summary: Integrated sensing and communication allows wireless networks to recognize human activity from the channel estimates that the receiver computes anyway. The inference, however, runs on the general-purpose processors of the base station, access point or handset, which are the first components a device switches off to save energy. Always-on sensing therefore requires a classifier that is small enough to remain powered while the rest of the system sleeps. We investigate whether Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) can provide such a classifier. To this end, we generate SNN accelerators for micro-Doppler activity recognition on the public DISC dataset (IEEE 802.11ay at 60 GHz) with the open-source Spiker+ framework, and implement them together with a spike encoder on a ZCU208 RFSoC, so that the complete chain from micro-Doppler frame to activity label runs in programmable logic. A fully connected SNN with 132 neurons achieves 94.7 % accuracy (90.7 % macro-F1) on unseen subjects and performs an inference in 206 microseconds. Compared to conventional networks of the same topology on the same device, it requires an eighth of the logic and 3.4X less dynamic energy per decision than a network fed the same binary spikes, at comparable accuracy, and 7.6X less than a network fed the 16-bit spectrogram, at 1.2 points lower accuracy. Quantization-aware training reduces its weights to 3 bits within half a percentage point of the 6-bit network at the same encoder threshold

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否用脉冲神经网络（SNN）作为"常开"的微多普勒人体活动识别分类器：用Spiker+框架在DISC数据集（60 GHz IEEE 802.11ay）上生成SNN硬件加速器，与脉冲编码器一起部署于ZCU208 RFSoC可编程逻辑中，实现从微多普勒帧到活动标签的全链路推理。132神经元的全连接SNN在新受试者上达94.7%准确率（macro-F1 90.7%），单次推理206微秒，逻辑资源仅为同拓扑常规网络的1/8，动态能耗显著更低；量化感知训练可将其权重压缩至3比特而精度损失小于0.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 通感一体化（ISAC）使无线网络能够利用接收端本就计算的信道估计进行人体活动识别，但推理通常运行在基站、AP或手机的通处理器上，而通用处理器恰恰是设备为节能最先关闭的部件。因此常开感知需要一个足够小、可在系统其余部分休眠时持续供电运行的分类器。作者旨在验证SNN能否胜任这一角色。
AI.method: 使用开源Spiker+框架在公开DISC数据集（60 GHz IEEE 802.11ay微多普勒数据）上自动生成SNN加速器，并将其与脉冲编码器共同实现在ZCU208 RFSoC上，使从微多普勒帧到活动标签的完整链路均运行于可编程逻辑中；采用全连接SNN（132个神经元），并与同器件上同拓扑的常规网络（分别输入相同二值脉冲与16位频谱图）对比资源占用、动态能耗与精度，同时评估量化感知训练对权重位宽的压缩效果。
AI.result: 132神经元全连接SNN在未见受试者上取得94.7%准确率（90.7% macro-F1），单次推理耗时206微秒；相比同器件同拓扑常规网络，逻辑资源仅需约1/8；每决策动态能耗比输入相同二值脉冲的网络低3.4倍（准确率相当），比输入16位频谱图的网络低7.6倍（准确率仅低1.2个百分点）；量化感知训练将权重量化至3比特，精度与6比特网络相差不足半个百分点（在相同编码器阈值下）。
AI.conclusion: SNN可作为常开通感活动识别的低功耗分类器：其事件驱动特性与硬件友好的紧凑结构在RFSoC可编程逻辑中实现了极低逻辑开销与动态能耗，同时保持高精度；结合量化感知训练进一步压缩权重位宽，为系统休眠期间的持续感知提供了可行方案。

title: Kernel Performance Engineering under Physical Non-Idealities
summary: Physical non-idealities in integrated circuit (IC) design and fabrication are concealed by conventional hardware abstractions, yet they can limit kernel performance and obscure optimization opportunities. Using distributed shared memory (DSMEM) on NVIDIA H100 GPUs as a case study, we show how floorsweeping restricts hardware resources available for clustered execution, potentially offsetting the benefits of reduced data movement enabled by DSMEM. Guided by these insights, we develop a wave-aware clustering strategy that accounts for these resource constraints to improve kernel performance. Evaluations using a global-load-and-broadcast microbenchmark, GEMM, and the Hopper version of FlashAttention 4 demonstrate the performance implications of these constraints, with wave-aware clustering improving FlashAttention 4 throughput by up to 5.30% over its baseline. We further show that, under thermal design power (TDP) limits, reduced data movement enables higher Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) frequencies through Dynamic Voltage and Frequency Scaling (DVFS), explaining otherwise unexpected throughput improvements. Extending this analysis beyond GPUs, we show that power constraints also limit throughput scaling on Tenstorrent's Wormhole accelerator, highlighting the broader importance of accounting for physical non-idealities when analyzing and optimizing kernel performance.

AI.tldr: 该文以 NVIDIA H100 的分布式共享内存（DSMEM）为案例，揭示 floorsweeping 等物理非理想性会削减可用于集群执行的硬件资源，并提出波次感知（wave-aware）集群策略以提升内核性能。
AI.motivation: 传统硬件抽象掩盖了 IC 设计与制造中的物理非理想性，这些非理想性会限制内核性能并掩盖优化机会；作者希望显式建模这些约束，以避免高估 DSMEM 减少数据搬运带来的收益。
AI.method: 以 H100 DSMEM 为案例研究 floorsweeping 对集群可用资源的影响；据此设计波次感知的线程块集群划分/调度策略；使用全局加载-广播微基准、GEMM、Hopper 版 FlashAttention 4 进行评测，并结合 TDP 约束下的 DVFS 行为分析；进一步在 Tenstorrent Wormhole 加速器上验证功耗约束的影响。
AI.result: 微基准、GEMM 与 FlashAttention 4 均显示资源约束对性能有实质影响；波次感知集群策略使 FlashAttention 4 吞吐相比基线最高提升 5.30%；在 TDP 限制下，减少数据搬运可经 DVFS 提升 SM 频率，从而解释原本意外的吞吐提升；Wormhole 加速器上功耗约束同样限制吞吐扩展。
AI.conclusion: 分析与优化内核性能时必须考虑物理非理想性（floorsweeping、功耗/TDP、DVFS 等），该视角不仅适用于 GPU，也适用于其他加速器架构。

title: AnalogScout: Simulation-Efficient PVT-Aware Analog Sizing with LLM Agents
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027
summary: Analog device sizing must satisfy all specifications across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners to ensure tape-out success, but simulating every candidate at all corners dominates the sizing time and slows design iteration. Conventional surrogate-based optimizers search the sizing space directly, while recent large language model (LLM) agents add circuit knowledge to designs but still delegate the sizes to global optimizers. Both learn the circuit response from repeated multi-corner SPICE simulations and optimize on top of it, which becomes expensive under a limited simulation budget. Providing an agent with reusable verified designs and sizing sub-blocks analytically could save most of this budget. We propose AnalogScout, a simulation-efficient PVT-aware sizing framework driven by an LLM agent. Combining elite-design reuse, analytic gm/Id local sizing and global refinement under full-corner verification, AnalogScout reduces power by 43.3% relative to the evolution strategy CMA-ES at an equal budget of 16k simulations on three SKY130 OTAs of increasing complexity, and reaches the final CMA-ES power after 7.0% of that budget. It also attains lower power than Bayesian optimization on all three OTAs and than two re-implemented LLM-driven flows on the two OTAs where they were tested.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnalogScout：一个由 LLM 智能体驱动、仿真高效的 PVT 感知模拟电路尺寸设计框架，通过精英设计复用、gm/Id 解析局部尺寸与全局精修相结合，大幅降低功耗与仿真预算。
AI.motivation: 传统替代模型优化器直接搜索尺寸空间、近期 LLM 智能体虽引入电路知识但仍把尺寸交给全局优化器；两者都依赖大量多角点 SPICE 仿真学习电路响应，在仿真预算受限时开销过大。若向智能体提供可复用的已验证设计和解析尺寸子模块，可节省大部分预算。
AI.method: AnalogScout 由 LLM 智能体驱动，融合三项机制：(1) 精英设计复用；(2) 基于 gm/Id 的解析局部尺寸设计；(3) 全局精修，并在完整 PVT 角点下进行验证。
AI.result: 在三个复杂度递增的 SKY130 OTA 上，于 16k 次仿真的同等预算下，功耗较进化策略 CMA-ES 降低 43.3%；仅用该预算的 7.0% 即达到 CMA-ES 的最终功耗；在全部三个 OTA 上功耗低于贝叶斯优化，并在测试过的两个 OTA 上优于两个重新实现的 LLM 驱动流程。
AI.conclusion: 将可复用已验证设计与解析 gm/Id 局部尺寸交由 LLM 智能体，可显著减少所需多角点仿真次数，在有限预算下实现更优的 PVT 感知尺寸设计。

title: Hardware-Matched Spiking Neural Networks for Real-Time Purkinje Cell Spike Classification
summary: Distinguishing Purkinje cell (PC) simple spikes (SSs) from complex spikes (CSs) is key to studying cerebellar function. PC recordings commonly rely on wired headstages, whose tethers restrict natural movement in freely behaving animals. Untethered headstages remove this constraint, but cannot continuously transmit raw recordings within their power budgets, making on-headstage spike classification an attractive form of compression, provided it runs accurately in real time on constrained hardware. This work presents two compact spiking neural networks (SNNs) matched to their target hardware: ConvSNN, which maps to the Matrix Vector Processor (MVP) of an EFM32PG28 microcontroller, and StreamSNN, which processes one waveform value per timestep using learned time constants and fixed synaptic delays for a dedicated SKY130 circuit. Evaluated on cells unseen during training, ConvSNN achieves a CS F1 of 0.873 with 1,018 parameters and StreamSNN 0.837 with 527 parameters, both with eight-bit weights. On the microcontroller, MVP acceleration reduces ConvSNN latency by 62.3\% and extends estimated battery life to 33.73~hours on a 50~mAh battery. In SKY130, StreamSNN occupies 0.173~mm$^2$ and consumes 0.46~$μ$J per event, with 0.2~ms of computation within an 8.3~ms end-to-end latency.

AI.tldr: 提出两种与目标硬件匹配的紧凑脉冲神经网络（ConvSNN与StreamSNN），用于在头戴式前端上实时区分浦肯野细胞简单锋电位与复杂锋电位，实现无线记录的数据压缩。
AI.motivation: 有线头戴前端束缚自由活动动物的自然运动；无线/无束缚前端受功耗预算限制无法持续传输原始神经记录，因此需要在片上实时、准确地完成锋电位分类以压缩数据。
AI.method: 设计两种紧凑SNN并分别映射到目标硬件：ConvSNN映射至EFM32PG28微控制器的矩阵向量处理器（MVP）；StreamSNN每时间步处理单个波形采样值，使用可学习时间常数与固定突触延迟，面向专用SKY130电路。两者均采用8位权重，并在训练未见的细胞上评估。
AI.result: ConvSNN在1,018参数下取得CS F1=0.873，StreamSNN在527参数下取得0.837。微控制器上MVP加速使ConvSNN延迟降低62.3%，50 mAh电池下估计续航达33.73小时；SKY130中StreamSNN占用0.173 mm²，每事件能耗0.46 μJ，计算耗时0.2 ms，端到端延迟8.3 ms。
AI.conclusion: 硬件-算法协同设计的紧凑SNN可在严格功耗与资源约束下实现跨细胞泛化的实时SS/CS分类，支持无束缚自由行为的小脑电生理记录。

title: p-DCIM: A 28nm Probabilistic SRAM DCIM based Ising Machine for Near-Memory Context Selection in LLM-RAG Pipeline
summary: We present a fabricated SRAM DCIM Ising machine that performs set-level context selection for large language model (LLM) with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). In RAG, the evidence-selection stage is increasingly delegated to repeated language-model reranking, which adds substantial energy to the inference pipeline. We reformulate evidence selection as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem and solve it on a dual-mode digital compute-in-memory (DCIM) macro: the same multiply-and-accumulate datapath computes the embedding-similarity scores that populate the QUBO coefficients and evaluates the per-spin Hamiltonian differences that drive the anneal. The annealing temperature is set by a digital plane-count control along with the SRAM pseudo-read random bit flips, giving graded cooling entirely from on-chip digital configuration. The macro is taped-out in a 28 nm process [0.16 mm2, 0.41 mW] and is proposed to be integrated as part of the logic base-die in hybrid high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and high-bandwidth flash (HBF) stacks in a GPU package, where only the selected passage identifiers return to the host. Replacing the language-model selection pass with the near-memory Ising solver yields a macro normalized selection-energy estimate more than six orders of magnitude lower than the LLM-based baseline and reduces the evaluated total energy per query by 67%, while maintaining comparable token-level F1 on the evaluated examples.

AI.tldr: 提出一款28 nm SRAM数字存内计算(DCIM)伊辛机芯片，将RAG证据选择建模为QUBO并用片上退火求解，替代LM重排序，选择能效估算低6个数量级以上，单查询总能耗降低67%，token级F1相当。
AI.motivation: RAG中的证据选择阶段越来越多地依赖反复的语言模型重排序，给推理流水线带来显著能耗开销，因此需要一种低能耗的选择机制。
AI.method: 将证据选择重构为QUBO问题；采用双模DCIM宏，用同一乘累加数据通路既计算嵌入相似度以填充QUBO系数，又评估驱动退火的逐自旋哈密顿量差分；退火温度由数字平面计数控制配合SRAM伪读随机位翻转实现片上数字可配置的分级降温。芯片在28 nm工艺流片(0.16 mm²、0.41 mW)，并拟作为混合HBM/HBF堆栈逻辑基芯的一部分集成于GPU封装，仅将选中的段落标识返回主机。
AI.result: 宏归一化选择能耗估算比基于LLM的基线低六个数量级以上；在所评估样例上每查询总能耗降低67%，同时保持可比的token级F1。
AI.conclusion: 近存伊辛求解器可有效替代语言模型选择通路，在保持精度的同时显著降低RAG推理能耗，并具备与HBM/HBF近存架构集成的可行性。

title: Comparative Analysis of Large Load Interconnection Requirements Across U.S. Transmission Entities
summary: The rapid growth of large loads, especially data centers driven by artificial intelligence, is creating unprecedented demands on the North American electric grid. Data centers now account for nearly 80% of large load interconnection requests in the Western Interconnection, and U.S. electricity consumption from data centers is projected to reach 325-580 TWh by 2028. Despite this urgency, technical interconnection requirements for large loads have not yet matured and still contain several gaps. This paper presents a comparative analysis of large load interconnection requirements across eleven U.S. entities, including AEP, Ameren, CAISO, Dominion, Duke Energy, ERCOT, LIPA, MISO, PJM, Southern Company, and SPP, under seven technical categories: large load definition, load data and modeling, fault ride-through, load curtailment and shedding, dispatchability, power quality, and reactive power control. The analysis reveals significant variation in both the scope and specificity of requirements. LIPA addresses all seven technical categories at least partially, while Dominion and Duke Energy provide detailed coverage across nearly all categories. The analysis also finds that data center applicants can be viewed as potential grid resources, rather than only as consumers. The findings provide a structured baseline from which utilities, regulators, ISOs/RTOs, and developers can identify gaps, benchmark against peers, and accelerate the development of interconnection standards.

AI.tldr: 该文对北美11家电力实体（AEP、CAISO、ERCOT、PJM等）的大负荷并网技术要求进行七维度比较分析，揭示各实体在要求范围与细化程度上差异显著，并指出数据中心申请者可被视为潜在电网资源。
AI.motivation: AI驱动的数据中心等大负荷快速增长，已占西部互联区大负荷并网申请的近80%，但大负荷并网技术要求尚未成熟、存在多处空白，缺乏系统性的横向比较基线。
AI.method: 选取11个美国电力实体，按七个技术类别（大负荷定义、负荷数据与建模、故障穿越、负荷削减与甩负荷、可调度性、电能质量、无功功率控制）对其并网要求进行对比分析。
AI.result: 各实体在要求覆盖范围与具体程度上差异明显：LIPA对全部七类均有至少部分覆盖，Dominion与Duke Energy在几乎所有类别上规定较为详尽；同时发现数据中心申请者可被定位为潜在电网资源而非单纯用户。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了结构化基线，可供公用事业公司、监管机构、ISO/RTO与开发商识别差距、对标同行，并加快并网标准制定。

title: Silent Blindness: Fault Vulnerability of Hardware Malware Detectors
summary: Hardware malware detectors (HMDs) classify hardware performance-counter measurements to identify malicious execution. Faults in their decision logic or parameters can weaken detection and allow malware to be classified as benign. We investigate this vulnerability through structural fault injection across a design space comprising 18 classifiers, four counter budgets, and AdaBoost and Bagging ensembles. The simulation evaluates 453,174 decision stuck-at and selected parameter bit-flip events on a 7,400-instance. Primary comparisons use 128 completed configurations. These completed-subset results are distinguished from the simulation summaries covering 140 configurations with enumerable fault sites. Fault outcomes are classified by their security consequences, including evasion, false-alarm increases, and metric silence. A fault is critical when malware recall decreases by at least five percentage points. Tree-based models exhibit a lower mean critical-fault fraction than function-based models, 5.3% versus 14.3%; exhaustive-only analysis preserves this ordering. Moreover, 72.3% of evaluated tree faults are metric-silent, changing both recall and false-positive rate by less than 0.1 percentage points without necessarily preserving individual predictions. Among the 27 completed matched comparisons, Bagging reduces criticality in 26, whereas AdaBoost increases it in two. Finally, an exact minimax selection method identifies protection candidates under additive unit costs and ideal correction. For a representative J48 detector, protecting 16 of 115 structural units reduces predicted maximum recall loss from 60.1 to 3.3 percentage points. These results characterize structural-model sensitivity and potential protection benefits; faulted RTL correspondence and physical hardening overhead remain unvalidated.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构故障注入评估硬件恶意软件检测器（HMD）的脆弱性，发现树模型（尤其是Bagging集成）对关键故障的敏感度显著低于函数模型，并给出基于极小极大选择的关键单元保护方案。
AI.motivation: HMD依赖硬件性能计数器分类恶意执行，其决策逻辑或参数若发生故障可能削弱检测能力、使恶意软件被误判为良性；现有工作缺乏对结构级故障后果（规避、误报上升、指标静默）的系统刻画。
AI.method: 在18个分类器、4种计数器预算、AdaBoost与Bagging集成的设计空间上做结构故障注入仿真：注入453,174个决策卡滞与参数位翻转事件，实例集规模7,400；主比较基于128个完整配置，并与覆盖140个可枚举故障位点的仿真汇总区分；按安全后果（规避、误报增加、指标静默）分类故障，以召回下降≥5个百分点为关键故障判据；并用精确极小极大选择法在加性单位成本与理想修复假设下确定保护候选。
AI.result: 树模型的平均关键故障比例低于函数模型（5.3% vs 14.3%），仅用穷举分析仍保持该排序；72.3%的树模型故障为"指标静默"（召回与假阳率变化均<0.1个百分点，但不一定保持单个预测不变）；27组匹配比较中Bagging在26组降低关键性，AdaBoost在2组升高；对代表性J48检测器，保护115个结构单元中的16个可将预测最大召回损失从60.1个百分点降至3.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了HMD结构模型的故障敏感性与潜在保护收益；但故障RTL对应关系与物理加固开销尚未验证。

title: A State Augmented Approach to Paralle Modeling in High-Level Synthesis
summary: High-level synthesis (HLS) can schedule only the concurrency made legal by its input description. For feedback-coupled designs, a sequential behavioral model can obscure the architectural state boundaries and hazard resolution needed for efficient overlap. We develop an explicit architectural modeling methodology based on synchronous sequential processes that start in lockstep and synchronize completion before repeating. Persistent state, communication, and feedback control are represented in C++, while HLS schedules and binds operations within that structure. A five-stage RV32I processor illustrates three consequential modeling decisions: which version of a value a consumer reads, when it consumes that value, and how architectural memory actions map to port operations. On a Kintex UltraScale+ FPGA, the CPI-optimized configuration achieves 1.221 cycles per instruction at 220 MHz, compared with 4.000 for an algorithmic HLS baseline and 1.575 at 242 MHz for an Ibex reference. An area-optimized configuration reduces LUTs by 65\% and registers by 47\%, with 9.7\% more benchmark cycles and a 250 MHz achieved clock. These results demonstrate a separation between designer-controlled architecture and tool-controlled scheduling.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于同步时序进程的显式架构建模方法，将持久状态、通信与反馈控制用C++表达，由HLS负责调度与绑定；以五级RV32I处理器验证，CPI优化配置达1.221 CPI@220 MHz，优于算法式HLS基线（4.000）和Ibex（1.575@242 MHz）。
AI.motivation: HLS只能调度输入描述中已被合法化的并发；对于反馈耦合设计，顺序行为模型会掩盖架构状态边界与冒险消解，导致难以获得高效的重叠执行。作者希望将"架构设计"与"工具调度"分离，由设计者掌控架构结构。
AI.method: 采用同步时序进程（synchronous sequential processes）的显式架构建模方法：各进程以锁步方式启动，并在重复前同步完成。持久状态、通信与反馈控制均以C++显式表达，HLS仅在既定结构内进行调度与绑定。以五级RV32I处理器为例，讨论三个关键建模决策：消费者读取哪个版本的值、何时消费该值、架构存储操作如何映射到端口操作。
AI.result: 在Kintex UltraScale+ FPGA上：CPI优化配置达1.221 CPI、220 MHz；算法式HLS基线为4.000 CPI；Ibex参考实现为1.575 CPI、242 MHz。面积优化配置LUT减少65%、寄存器减少47%，基准周期增加9.7%，时钟达250 MHz。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了"设计者控制架构、工具控制调度"这一分离范式的有效性：显式架构建模使反馈耦合设计获得接近甚至超越手写RTL参考的性能，同时保留HLS的可编程性与面积/性能权衡空间。

title: zkDuel: Characterizing SumCheck Prover Kernels across GPU Programming Models
comment: Accepted to HASP'26 at MICRO 2026
summary: SumCheck is a central prover primitive in zero-knowledge proofs, exposing table-parallel work that maps naturally to GPUs but becomes increasingly arithmetic-intensive as finite fields widen. We study how this shift affects the cost of programming SumCheck in Triton rather than CUDA. Our benchmark, zkDuel, provides matched implementations of 25 zkPHIRE-derived constraints alongside diagnostic polynomials, covering 32-, 64-, 128-, and 256-bit prime fields, with independent CPU-reference validation and cross-backend checksum gating. Of 800 configurations attempted on an NVIDIA H100, 758 complete with matching checksums. CUDA's median advantage over Triton falls from 3.5x at 32 bits to 1.4x at 256 bits, and Triton is faster on 19 large-table configurations; the same convergence appears on an A100, where the gap falls from 4.4x to 1.6x. Profiling shows that the small-field gap largely reflects host launch overhead and redundant modular additions in Triton's original block reduction, whose relative costs diminish as multi-limb Montgomery work grows. Replacing that reduction with tl.reduce brings Triton's median kernel time within 8% of CUDA on both GPUs, while specialized point interpolation improves 256-bit evaluation kernels by 1.55-1.75x. At cryptographic widths, these results show that a Python-embedded DSL can approach CUDA performance, although the largest fully unrolled constraints still expose compiler-scalability limits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 zkDuel 基准，在 32/64/128/256 位素域上比较 Triton 与 CUDA 编写的 SumCheck 内核，发现 CUDA 相对优势随域宽增大从 3.5x 收敛至 1.4x，并通过改用 tl.reduce 与专用点插值使 Triton 内核中位时间逼近 CUDA 8% 以内。
AI.motivation: SumCheck 是零知识证明的核心证明原语，其表并行结构天然适合 GPU，但随着有限域位宽增大，算术（多 limb Montgomery 运算）强度显著上升，这一变化可能改变 Triton（Python 嵌入式 DSL）与 CUDA 之间的性价比权衡，而此前缺乏系统的量化对比。
AI.method: 构建基准 zkDuel：提供 25 个源自 zkPHIRE 的约束的 CUDA/Triton 匹配实现，并辅以诊断性多项式；覆盖 32/64/128/256 位素域；采用独立的 CPU 参考实现校验，并以跨后端校验和门控保证正确性。在 NVIDIA H100 与 A100 上运行 800 组配置，通过 profiling 定位性能差异来源，并尝试两项优化：用 tl.reduce 替换原块归约、采用专用点插值。
AI.result: H100 上 800 组配置中 758 组完成且校验和一致。CUDA 相对 Triton 的中位优势从 32 位的 3.5x 降至 256 位的 1.4x，且 Triton 在 19 个大表配置上更快；A100 上同样收敛（4.4x → 1.6x）。Profiling 表明小域差距主要来自主机端启动开销与 Triton 原块归约中的冗余模加，其相对成本随多 limb Montgomery 运算占比上升而下降。改用 tl.reduce 后，两卡上 Triton 内核中位时间均在 CUDA 的 8% 以内；专用点插值使 256 位求值内核提升 1.55–1.75x。
AI.conclusion: 在密码学常用域宽下，Python 嵌入式 DSL（Triton）可以接近 CUDA 性能，差距主要源于可修复的归约实现与启动开销而非语言本身；但最大规模的全展开约束仍暴露出编译器可扩展性瓶颈。

title: Search-Guided Reasoning Trace Curation for Verilog Generation
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation. However, most training pipelines distill natural-language reasoning traces whose intermediate design decisions are weakly structured and are primarily selected according to the correctness of the final generated RTL. We present MCTS-SFT, a verifier-guided framework for curating reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of Verilog generation models. MCTS-SFT formulates trace construction as search over intermediate reasoning states and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to propagate functional feedback from complete Verilog rollouts to earlier design decisions. Within this framework, we introduce Plan-MCTS, which searches over compact hardware-design plans that explicitly represent interfaces, timing, state, behavior, and update rules. We further study plan-preserving supervision, in which the searched structured state is retained as part of the downstream SFT target. Our experiments find that Plan-MCTS achieves the highest functional trace yield, with 84.2% correct traces compared with 81.9% for one-shot structured planning and 82.0% for unguided tree exploration. For identical Plan-MCTS trajectories and Verilog outputs, retaining the explicit searched plan during SFT raises pass@10 from 52.56% to 57.7%, demonstrating that the representation of intermediate design decisions materially affects downstream learning. In a separate 6,000-trace study, MCTS-curated supervision improves pass@10 over full-response chain-of-thought distillation by up to 3.7 points while reducing downstream generation length by approximately 50% on VerilogEval-v2. These results demonstrate that structured hardware planning, verifier-guided search, and explicit intermediate-state supervision provide complementary mechanisms for constructing more effective and token-efficient training data for Verilog generation.

AI.tldr: MCTS-SFT：用蒙特卡洛树搜索与验证器引导构造Verilog生成的推理轨迹，并保留显式硬件设计计划作为监督目标。
AI.motivation: 现有Verilog生成SFT数据多从自然语言推理轨迹蒸馏而来，其中间设计决策结构松散，且主要按最终RTL正确性来筛选，导致中间步骤的监督信号弱。
AI.method: 提出验证器引导的推理轨迹筛选框架MCTS-SFT，将轨迹构造建模为对中间推理状态的搜索，用MCTS把完整Verilog仿真的功能反馈回传到早期决策；在此基础上提出Plan-MCTS，在紧凑的硬件设计计划（显式表示接口、时序、状态、行为与更新规则）空间上搜索；并研究"计划保留式监督"，即把搜索得到的有结构状态保留为下游SFT目标的一部分。
AI.result: Plan-MCTS功能正确轨迹产出率最高，达84.2%，优于一次性结构化规划的81.9%和无引导树搜索的82.0%；相同轨迹与Verilog输出下，SFT保留显式计划使pass@10从52.56%升至57.7%；另在6,000条轨迹研究中，MCTS筛选监督相较全响应CoT蒸馏在VerilogEval-v2上pass@10最高提升3.7个点，同时生成长度减少约50%。
AI.conclusion: 结构化硬件规划、验证器引导搜索与显式中间状态监督三种机制互补，可构造更有效且token更高效的Verilog生成训练数据。

title: Whole-Route Planning of a Memory Bus Between Two BGAs: An Exact Model of Crossings and Layer Changes, Negotiated to DRC-Clean Copper
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 1 table
summary: Routing the bus between a processor and its DRAM remains largely manual in printed circuit board (PCB) design, and published algorithms optimize proxies such as crossing or layer counts. We present a router that plans every lane of a two-layer BGA-to-BGA bus before any copper is laid, and carries the plan to design-rule-clean copper. Its core is an exact constraint-programming model that chooses, for all lanes at once, where each necessary crossing occurs, in what order -- by a rule over every triple of lanes -- and where each lane changes layer, with via room; for the ends it is given, it proves its plan optimal within the model. The model reads naturally as physics: worldlines, frustrated Ising spins and contact forces. A linear program places the lanes in millimeters; the constraints it must violate return to the model as cuts, and audit findings as negotiated congestion prices, until the plan passes an audit against the production router's rules or lays clean. The escapes are chosen by an estimate of the same objective, and differential pairs carry their polarity, with an automatic via crossover where the ends disagree.
