On an Allwinner H3 and a Zynq-7020, each to a DDR3 device, the router completes every rung of two ladders, of up to 51 nets on the H3 (its whole bus) and 43 on the Zynq, connected and DRC-clean, never with more vias than the human designer (80 against 88 and 62 against 100 at the top rungs) and always with less copper, where the toolkit's production router leaves nets open on four of the ten rungs and Freerouting completes none. On the Zynq board itself it completes 45 of the bus's nets with 70 vias to the designer's 105. On generated buses of three, four and six routing layers every run completes, and every one with a known optimum attains it.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在铺铜前统一规划双层BGA-to-BGA总线的布线器，核心是同时对全体线道做精确约束规划（决定交叉位置、交叉次序与换层次），再经线性规划毫米级布线、以割和拥塞价格迭代修正，最终产出连通且DRC干净的铜箔。
AI.motivation: PCB中处理器与DRAM之间的总线布线仍大量依赖人工，已有算法只优化交叉数或层数等代理指标，无法在真正铺铜前给出可执行、可证明最优的整体方案。
AI.method: 用精确约束规划模型同时为所有线道选择每次必要交叉的发生位置与次序（对每个三元组线道的规则）及换层点并预留过孔空间；模型可类比为世界线、阻挫伊辛自旋与接触力；随后用线性规划在毫米尺度放置线道，将其违反的约束作为割返回模型、把审计结果作为协商式拥塞价格迭代，直至通过生产布线器规则审计或铺出干净铜箔；逃逸方向由同一目标估计选定，差分对保持极性并在端点不一致处自动过孔交叉。
AI.result: 在Allwinner H3与Zynq-7020（各连DDR3）上，两级阶梯测试全部完成，H3最大51网（整条总线）、Zynq最大43网，全部连通且DRC干净；过孔数不超过人工设计（顶层80对88、62对100），铜面积始终更小；而工具包自带生产布线器在10级中4级留有开路，Freerouting全部失败。在Zynq板上完成45条总线网、70个过孔（人工为105）。在3/4/6层生成总线上每次运行均完成，已知最优的算例全部达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 将全局组合决策（交叉位置/次序/换层）交给精确约束规划、把几何细节交给线性规划与审计反馈的分解式流程，可在双层乃至多层BGA-DRAM总线上稳定得到优于人工、DRC干净且近最优的布线结果。

title: ADACT: PDE-Constrained Thermal Hardware/Software Co-Design Adjoint-Driven Optimal Control via Finite Difference Discretization
summary: By virtue of the sheer compute demands of large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing (HPC), modern multi-core microprocessors suffer from severe power density limits and thermal throttling, entailing an urgent need for principled methods for predictive, physics-informed dynamical thermal management (DTM). Here, we introduce a hardware/software co-design physics-informed PDE-constrained DTM throttling optimal control algorithm, ADACT (Adjoint-Driven Adaptive Co-Design Thermal Control), that minimizes thermal risk and cooling energy overhead while maximizing core execution throughput. The underlying physical temperature field is governed by a two-dimensional nonhomogeneous parabolic reaction-diffusion equation with spatially localized, time-varying power source terms and variable convective cooling subject to nonhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. We employ a discretization of the continuous state PDE via a Crank-Nicolson finite difference scheme with a 5-point discrete Laplacian operator on a uniform spatial mesh, which preserves unconditional numerical stability and $O(Δx^2 + Δy^2 + Δt^2)$ second-order temporal and spatial accuracy. To efficiently compute exact gradients, we construct and implement a continuous backward-in-time adjoint state method with L-BFGS as our optimization algorithm of choice. The accuracy and second-order convergence rates of both forward state and backward adjoint solvers are quantitatively verified via the Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS), and gradient accuracy is validated using directional derivative Taylor tests. Numerical experiments demonstrate that ADACT dynamically throttles software power workloads and modulates hardware cooling efforts to strictly uphold physical thermal thresholds while maintaining operational throughput.

AI.tldr: 提出硬件/软件协同设计的物理信息PDE约束热节流最优控制算法 ADACT，以Crank–Nicolson有限差分+反向伴随状态法+L-BFGS求解，在满足热约束的同时最大化吞吐、降低冷却能耗。
AI.motivation: 大规模AI与HPC的算力需求使多核处理器面临严重功率密度限制与热节流，亟需有原理支撑的、物理信息驱动的预测性动态热管理（DTM）方法。
AI.method: 将温度场建模为二维非齐次抛物型反应-扩散方程，含空间局部化、时变功率源项与变对流冷却，边界为非齐次Dirichlet条件；用Crank–Nicolson格式与五点离散Laplacian在均匀网格上离散（无条件稳定，二阶时空精度）；采用连续时间反向伴随状态法求精确梯度，配L-BFGS优化；用MMS验证前向/伴随求解器的二阶收敛率，用方向导数Taylor测试验证梯度精度。
AI.result: MMS定量验证了前向状态与反向伴随求解器均具二阶收敛率，Taylor测试确认梯度正确；数值实验表明ADACT可动态调节软件功率负载与硬件冷却强度，在严格维持物理热阈值的同时保持运行吞吐。
AI.conclusion: ADACT为热风险、冷却能耗与执行吞吐之间的多目标权衡提供了可验证、物理一致的PDE约束最优控制框架，适用于芯片级DTM的软硬件协同节流。

title: Realizing Low-Precision Storage and Sparse Execution in a Folded FPGA Speech Enhancer
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ISCAS 2027
summary: Hardware-aware training often optimizes FPGA resources, latency, or bit operations, but folding changes what compression saves: shared arithmetic decouples precision, weight storage, and scheduled work. We derive training objectives from the measured costs of a folded streaming speech-enhancement accelerator. Mixed-precision weights reduce on-chip storage; structured channel sparsity removes entire operations from the engine schedule. We deploy a bit-exact implementation on the Kria KV260. The best sparse model eliminates 47.3% of convolution MACs, cutting frame time by 45% (1.86 to 1.03 ms) and dynamic energy by 60% (83 to 33 $μ$J/frame) against a storage-priced model measured in the same session, with higher speech quality. Relative to the most efficient dense build measured separately, frame time falls by 42% and energy by 48%. Reducing weight width from 8 to 6 bits lowers dynamic power by 27% but changes frame time by less than 5%. Plain channel group-lasso removes more work than cycle-cost-weighted lasso. Thus, folded-accelerator training should price storage and removable work separately, rather than rely on a single bit-operation metric.

AI.tldr: 针对折叠式流式语音增强FPGA加速器，用实测代价分别驱动混合精度权重与结构化通道稀疏训练；在Kria KV260上比特精确部署后，最佳稀疏模型消去47.3%卷积MAC，帧时降45%、动态能耗降60%，且语音质量更优。
AI.motivation: 硬件感知训练常以FPGA资源、时延或比特运算量为优化目标，但折叠（分时复用算术单元）改变了压缩真正能节省的对象：共享算术使精度、权重存储与调度工作量相互解耦，单一比特运算指标无法反映实际收益。
AI.method: 从折叠式流式语音增强加速器的实测代价出发推导训练目标：混合精度权重用于降低片上存储（按存储定价），结构化通道稀疏用于从引擎调度中整块移除运算（按可移除工作量定价）；在Kria KV260上做比特精确实现并同会话对比，方案包括 cycle-cost 加权 lasso 与普通 channel group-lasso。
AI.result: 最佳稀疏模型消去47.3%卷积MAC，相对同会话测得的存储定价模型帧时由1.86 ms降至1.03 ms（−45%）、动态能耗由83 μJ/帧降至33 μJ/帧（−60%），语音质量更高；相对另行测得的最优稠密实现，帧时降42%、能耗降48%。权重由8 bit降至6 bit使动态功率降27%，但帧时变化不足5%；普通 channel group-lasso 比 cycle-cost 加权 lasso 移除更多工作量。
AI.conclusion: 折叠加速器的硬件感知训练应将“存储代价”与“可移除工作量代价”分开定价，而非依赖单一比特运算指标。

title: Detection of Single Stuck-at and Bridging Faults in Cluster-based FPGA Architectures
comment: 13 pages, VDAT 2007 conference, India
summary: This paper presents a new technique for detecting single stuck-at and bridging faults in cluster-based FPGA architectures, using same set of test vectors generated by a test pattern generator circuitry. This technique is based on configuration of logic elements using test logic structure and the outputs of two separated logic elements are compared to detect a fault. To do this, block under test, TPG and output response analysis circuitry are generated in FPGAs. The configurations of test pattern generation, block under test and output response analysis are also discussed in this paper. The novelty lies in the fact that the same set of test vectors can detect all the stuck-at as well as bridging faults if the test vectors are applied in a particular sequence and analyzing the output results. We presented a detail analysis of results to detect faults as well.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于簇结构FPGA的故障检测技术，利用同一组由测试向量生成器（TPG）电路产生的测试向量，同时检测固定型（stuck-at）故障与桥接（bridging）故障。
AI.motivation: 簇结构（cluster-based）FPGA中逻辑单元密集、互连复杂，固定型与桥接故障均需覆盖；而分别针对两类故障设计测试向量会显著增加测试成本与面积开销，因此需要一套统一、可内建自测试（BIST）化的检测方案。
AI.method: 在FPGA内部综合出测试向量生成器（TPG）、被测模块（BUT）和输出响应分析电路；通过测试逻辑结构对逻辑单元进行配置，将两个相互独立的逻辑单元的输出进行比较以判定故障；并给出TPG、BUT与输出响应分析三部分的具体配置方案。关键在于以特定顺序施加同一组测试向量，并结合输出结果分析。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在按特定序列施加该组测试向量的条件下，同一组测试向量即可覆盖全部固定型故障与桥接故障；论文对检测结果进行了详细分析，验证了该方法的故障检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以统一测试向量集、比较式双逻辑单元结构和片内BIST电路实现了对固定型与桥接故障的联合检测，降低了测试向量生成与测试施加的复杂度，适用于簇结构FPGA的在线/内建测试。

title: When and Why to Use TMA: A Workload-Grounded Characterization of Tensor Memory Acceleration on NVIDIA Hopper GPUs
comment: Accepted to IISCW'26
summary: The Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), introduced on NVIDIA Hopper, is used pervasively in production GPU kernels yet its usage is conspicuously selective: expert kernel developers in CUTLASS, FlashAttention-3, and FlashInfer apply TMA to some tensor operands within a kernel but fall back to cp.async, direct global loads, or distributed shared memory (DSM) for others. Vendor documentation describes the API, and recent microbenchmarking work characterizes TMA throughput in isolation, but neither answers the question practitioners actually face: given a memory operand in a kernel, should it use TMA, and if so, with or without cluster multicast? We address this gap with a workload-grounded characterization study on H100. We catalog the TMA, multicast, DSM, and cp.async choices made inside FlashAttention-3 forward, isolate the discriminating features through targeted microbenchmarks (transfer-size crossover, multicast scaling), and produce rules of thumb for the load-mechanism choice on Hopper. We further compare TMA multicast against DSM as competing cluster-broadcast primitives, and isolate the FlashAttention-3 paged-key-value (KV) TMA-vs-cp.async dispatch on H100 across page size, datatype, model shape, and execution phase. Our results yield concrete, predictive guidance on when TMA pays off and when multicast helps or hurts on Hopper, and we extend the analysis to server Blackwell (SM100) via a CUTLASS GEMM study on B200 that shows the qualitative dispatch rules carry across generations while absolute crossovers shift with tensor-core and bandwidth scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文在 H100 上对 TMA、multicast、DSM 与 cp.async 的选用进行工作负载驱动的刻画研究：以 FlashAttention-3 为对象拆解其算子级选择，用微基准分离判别特征，给出 Hopper 装载机制选择的经验规则，并对比 TMA multicast 与 DSM，最后在 B200（SM100）上验证规则的跨代可迁移性。
AI.motivation: TMA 在 Hopper 上被广泛使用，但生产级内核（CUTLASS、FlashAttention-3、FlashInfer）对其使用明显有选择性：部分张量操作数用 TMA，另一些则退回 cp.async、全局直读或 DSM。厂商文档只描述 API，近期微基准只刻画孤立吞吐，均无法回答实践者真正面对的问题：某个内存操作数是否该用 TMA，以及是否配合 cluster multicast。该空白导致装载机制选择缺乏可预测依据。
AI.method: 在 H100 上开展工作负载驱动的刻画研究：(1) 系统梳理 FlashAttention-3 前向中 TMA、multicast、DSM、cp.async 的实际选择；(2) 通过定向微基准分离判别特征，包括传输尺寸交叉点与 multicast 扩展性；(3) 归纳 Hopper 上装载机制选择的经验规则；(4) 将 TMA multicast 与 DSM 作为竞争性的 cluster 广播原语进行对比；(5) 针对 FlashAttention-3 的分页 KV 场景，在页大小、数据类型、模型形状与执行阶段各维度上分离 TMA 与 cp.async 的调度边界；(6) 通过 B200 上的 CUTLASS GEMM 研究将分析扩展至 Blackwell（SM100）。
AI.result: 给出关于 TMA 何时收益为正、multicast 何时有利或有害的具体且具预测性的指导；明确传输尺寸交叉点与 multicast 扩展行为；刻画分页 KV 在页大小、数据类型、模型形状和执行阶段上的 TMA/cp.async 分派边界；B200 上的 GEMM 研究表明定性分派规则可跨代沿用，而绝对交叉点随张量核心与带宽的规模变化而移动。
AI.conclusion: TMA 的采用不应是全局开关，而应按操作数粒度依据传输尺寸、是否可 cluster 广播、执行阶段等因素分派；multicast 与 DSM 是可竞争的广播原语，需按场景取舍。所得规则在 Hopper 上具预测性，并可定性迁移到 Blackwell，但需按硬件规模重新标定交叉点。

title: PaFeDSE: Pareto-Feedback-Guided Microarchitecture Design Space Exploration for Efficient Pareto Search
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures. Accepted to ASP-DAC 2027
summary: Efficient microarchitecture design space exploration (DSE) is critical for optimizing performance, power, and area trade-offs in modern out-of-order processors. While machine-learning-based DSE significantly reduces the cost of exhaustively evaluating large design spaces, existing methods still waste expensive simulations on Pareto-miss candidates that do not improve the Pareto frontier and repeatedly process redundant candidates during iterative exploration. In this paper, we propose PaFeDSE, a Pareto-feedback-guided microarchitecture DSE framework for efficient Pareto search. PaFeDSE leverages Pareto-hit feedback to prioritize candidates likely to improve the frontier and Pareto-miss feedback to suppress exploration of unpromising local regions, while filtering redundant candidates that remain low priority across iterations. Evaluated on SPEC CPU 2017 workloads, PaFeDSE requires up to 49.0% fewer simulations than the strongest prior baseline to reach target hypervolume levels, while achieving a 7.1x reduction in exploration overhead through adaptive candidate filtering.

AI.tldr: 提出PaFeDSE，一种以帕累托反馈引导的微架构设计空间探索框架，通过利用Pareto-hit/miss反馈优先化候选并过滤冗余候选，在SPEC CPU 2017上相比最强基线最多减少49.0%的仿真次数，探索开销降低7.1倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的设计空间探索（DSE）虽降低了大设计空间的评估成本，但仍将昂贵仿真浪费在无法改进帕累托前沿的Pareto-miss候选上，且在迭代探索中反复处理冗余候选，效率不足。
AI.method: PaFeDSE利用Pareto-hit反馈优先选择可能改进前沿的候选，利用Pareto-miss反馈抑制对无前景局部区域的探索，并通过自适应候选过滤剔除在多轮迭代中持续低优先级的冗余候选。
AI.result: 在SPEC CPU 2017工作负载上，达到目标超体积水平所需仿真次数比最强先前基线最多减少49.0%，并通过自适应候选过滤使探索开销降低7.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 帕累托反馈引导与冗余候选过滤能显著提升乱序处理器微架构DSE的帕累托搜索效率，减少仿真成本与探索开销。

title: SPARTA: A Sparse Ternary LLM Accelerator with Adaptive Attention and Unified Datapath for Long-Context Edge Inference
summary: LLMs on edge devices are constrained by limited memory and bandwidth. Although 1.58-bit ternary weights greatly reduce model storage, long-context inference is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache traffic and attention. Existing accelerators also use separate datapaths for ternary linear layers and attention, incurring hardware and execution overhead. We present SPARTA, a sparse ternary LLM accelerator for efficient long-context edge inference. SPARTA integrates: (1) a phase-aware sparse dataflow exploiting heterogeneous sparsity across compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode; (2) a unified compute fabric mapping ternary SpMM/SpMV and bit-serial attention onto shared processing elements to exploit zero-weight and zero-bit sparsity; and (3) an adaptive two-stage attention engine combining page-level Top-k selection to reduce K-cache accesses with token-level Top-p pruning to reduce V-cache traffic. SPARTA reduces KV traffic by 4.1-4.8x over full attention and 1.3-1.5x over a state-of-the-art sparse-attention scheme, with task-dependent quality loss. Compared with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, SPARTA achieves 3.9x higher generation throughput and 8.3x higher end-to-end energy efficiency on average; versus AMD Ryzen 7 9700X, the gains are 5.0x and 81.7x. It also delivers 1.6-12.0x higher throughput, 2.0-4.2x higher energy efficiency, and 1.3-51.4x higher area efficiency than FIGLUT, TeLLMe, and MCBP.

AI.tldr: SPARTA是一个面向边缘设备长上下文推理的稀疏三值LLM加速器，通过分阶段稀疏数据流、统一计算阵列和两级自适应注意力引擎，显著降低KV缓存流量并提升吞吐与能效。
AI.motivation: 边缘设备上的LLM受限于内存容量与带宽。1.58-bit三值权重虽大幅压缩存储，但长上下文推理的瓶颈转向KV-cache流量与注意力计算；现有加速器对三值线性层与注意力采用独立数据通路，带来硬件面积与执行开销。
AI.method: 提出SPARTA，包含三项设计：(1) 相位感知稀疏数据流，针对计算受限的prefill与访存受限的decode阶段利用异构稀疏性；(2) 统一计算阵列，将三值SpMM/SpMV与bit-serial注意力映射到共享处理单元，同时利用零权重稀疏与零比特稀疏；(3) 自适应两级注意力引擎，结合页级Top-k选择降低K-cache访问与Token级Top-p剪枝降低V-cache流量。
AI.result: KV流量相比全注意力降低4.1-4.8x，相比SOTA稀疏注意力方案降低1.3-1.5x（存在任务相关的质量损失）。相比NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin，生成吞吐提升3.9x、端到端能效提升8.3x；相比AMD Ryzen 7 9700X分别提升5.0x与81.7x。相比FIGLUT、TeLLMe、MCBP，吞吐提升1.6-12.0x，能效提升2.0-4.2x，面积效率提升1.3-51.4x。
AI.conclusion: SPARTA通过软硬件协同的稀疏化与统一数据通路设计，验证了在边缘设备上高效长上下文三值LLM推理的可行性，在KV流量、吞吐、能效与面积效率上均取得显著收益，代价是任务相关的生成质量损失。

title: MCF: A Memory- and Communication-Aware Co-Designed Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference
summary: This paper presents Memory- and Communication-Aware Framework for Long-Context LLM Inference (MCF) that optimizes long-context inference through communication-aware and stage-adaptive KV-cache layout transitions. At the core of MCF is {Memory-Aware Replication and Scheduling} (MARS), a dynamic orchestration mechanism for chunked prefill. MARS exploits early-stage memory headroom by selectively replicating highly reused KV blocks, improving locality and hiding KV propagation latency behind attention computation. As prefill progresses and memory pressure increases, MARS progressively drains redundant replicas and converges the KV cache into a sharded decode-ready layout, avoiding expensive layout conversion at the prefill--decode boundary. For decoding, MCF adopts a query-centric execution model in which KV shards remain stationary while lightweight query tensors are routed across workers. This changes communication from KV-cache-dependent transfer to query-dependent transfer, reducing communication growth with context length. MCF further integrates a hardware-software co-designed execution layer based on an FPGA compute-NIC datapath, enabling metadata-driven KV routing and collective operations directly in the network path. Experiments show that MCF improves TTFT, throughput, and scalability over state-of-the-art distributed inference systems, with larger benefits as context length and cluster size increase.

AI.tldr: MCF 是一个面向长上下文 LLM 推理的内存与通信感知框架，通过阶段自适应 KV-cache 布局转换（MARS 动态复制/调度）与查询中心解码执行模型，并结合 FPGA compute-NIC 软硬件协同，提升 TTFT、吞吐与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中 KV-cache 体量随上下文长度快速增长，带来显存压力与跨设备 KV 传播通信开销；prefill 与 decode 两阶段对内存与通信的需求不同，且边界处布局转换代价高，现有分布式系统难以兼顾。
AI.method: 核心为 MARS（Memory-Aware Replication and Scheduling）：在 chunked prefill 早期利用显存余量选择性复制高复用 KV 块，提升局部性并将 KV 传播延迟隐藏在注意力计算之后；随 prefill 推进与显存压力上升，逐步释放冗余副本，将 KV cache 收敛为分片、可直接解码的布局，避免 prefill–decode 边界的昂贵转换。解码阶段采用查询中心执行模型，KV 分片保持驻留，仅路由轻量 query 张量，使通信量由依赖 KV-cache 转为依赖 query，从而随上下文长度增长的通信开销更小。此外构建基于 FPGA compute-NIC 数据通路的软硬件协同执行层，在网络路径内实现元数据驱动的 KV 路由与集合通信。
AI.result: 实验表明，MCF 在 TTFT、吞吐量和可扩展性上优于当前先进的分布式推理系统，且上下文长度与集群规模越大，收益越显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过内存感知的 KV 复制/调度、阶段自适应布局收敛、查询中心解码通信范式以及 FPGA compute-NIC 网络内计算，MCF 有效缓解长上下文推理的显存与通信瓶颈，并具备良好的规模可扩展性。

title: ChroNoC: A Tableless TDM Circuit-Switched NoC With Delay-Aware Deployment for Time-Sensitive Neuromorphic Computing
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Time-sensitive neuromorphic architectures require predictable interconnects to preserve precise event timing. Statically scheduled time-division-multiplexed (TDM) circuit-switched networks-on-chip (NoCs) provide deterministic latency at the cost of linear configuration-memory scaling with schedule depth. Furthermore, jointly optimizing task placement, routing, and scheduling creates an intractable combinatorial search space. Existing deployment frameworks also ignore algorithmic axonal delays by forcing immediate spike injections that increase network contention. This paper proposes a hardware-software co-design to address these challenges. ChroNoC is a tableless TDM NoC that embeds precomputed full-grid broadcast trees into combinational logic as a fixed routing substrate. This fixed substrate reduces deployment to a spatial search via Delay-Aware Reservations and Spatial Annealing (DARSA). DARSA converts axonal delays into periodic scheduling slack to stagger network injections and reduce communication overhead. In a 130nm CMOS process, ChroNoC reduces per-hop energy consumption by more than 75% relative to the evaluated circuit- and packet-switched baselines. On UCI-HAR and N-MNIST workloads, DARSA reduces per-timestep communication cycles by approximately 60% and 45%, respectively, compared with immediate transmission, while also reducing provisioned communication memory. These results demonstrate how combining lightweight TDM switch design with delay-aware deployment improves both hardware efficiency and system-level communication performance while preserving neural event timing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出软硬件协同设计的 ChroNoC：一种无表 TDM NoC，将以预计算全网格广播树固化在组合逻辑中作为固定路由基底，从而把部署问题降维为基于延迟感知预留与空间退火（DARSA）的空间搜索，在保持神经事件时序的同时降低能耗与通信开销。
AI.motivation: 时间敏感的神经形态架构需要可预测的互连以保住精确事件时序。已有静态调度 TDM 电路交换 NoC 虽具确定性延迟，但配置存储随调度深度线性增长；同时联合优化任务放置、路由与调度构成难解的组合搜索空间。此外现有部署框架忽略算法层面的轴突延迟，强制立即注入脉冲，加剧网络拥塞。
AI.method: 软硬件协同设计。硬件侧 ChroNoC 是表式（tableless）TDM NoC，将预计算的全网格广播树嵌入组合逻辑，形成固定路由基底；软件侧 DARSA（Delay-Aware Reservations and Spatial Annealing）在该固定基底上把部署转化为空间搜索，并将轴突延迟转化为周期性调度松弛，以错开网络注入、降低通信开销。
AI.result: 130nm CMOS 工艺下，ChroNoC 相比所评估的电路交换与分组交换基线，单跳能耗降低逾 75%。在 UCI-HAR 与 N-MNIST 负载上，DARSA 相比立即传输分别将每时间步通信周期数减少约 60% 与 45%，同时降低所需配置的通信存储。
AI.conclusion: 将轻量 TDM 交换设计与延迟感知部署相结合，可在保持神经事件时序的前提下同时提升硬件效率与系统级通信性能。

title: Toward Near-Optimal Floorplanning with Complex Design Constraints for Modern SoCs
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, Accepted by International Conference on Computer-Aided Design (ICCAD) 2026
summary: Modern system-on-chip (SoC) floorplanning is increasingly challenged by highly coupled complex design constraints. Existing methods often relax constraints into objectives via multi-objective optimization, leading to infeasible solutions or degraded quality. To address this, we formulate the problem as a constrained optimization task and propose a novel three-stage analytical framework integrating semidefinite programming (SDP), augmented Lagrangian method (ALM), and second-order cone programming (SOCP), which enforces constraints more rigorously and achieves higher-quality solutions. First, we adopt a two-step SDP formulation to obtain a robust initialization in the non-convex search space. Next, we incorporate differentiable objectives and constraints into an incremental ALM to jointly handle coupled design constraints during global floorplanning. Finally, an SOCP-based legalization strictly enforces feasibility while further reducing area. Experiments on the FloorSet benchmark show that our method satisfies all constraints with the fastest runtime. Compared with state-of-the-art methods, it reduces wirelength and area by 90\% and 16\% on average, and achieves near-optimal results, with wirelength and area being merely 2\% and 1\% larger than the ground-truth references, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段解析式SoC布局框架（SDP+增广拉格朗日+SOCP），以严格约束优化替代多目标松弛，在FloorSet上全部满足约束且运行最快，线长和面积平均降低90%和16%，接近最优。
AI.motivation: 现代SoC布局面临高度耦合的复杂设计约束；现有方法将约束松弛为目标函数做多目标优化，导致解不可行或质量下降。
AI.method: 将问题建模为约束优化任务：1）两步SDP公式，在非凸搜索空间获得稳健初始化；2）将可微目标与约束纳入增量式增广拉格朗日方法（ALM），在全局布局中联合处理耦合约束；3）基于SOCP的合法化严格保证可行性并进一步减小面积。
AI.result: 在FloorSet基准上，该方法满足全部约束且运行时间最短；相比SOTA，线长和面积平均分别降低90%和16%；结果接近最优，线长与面积仅比ground-truth参考大2%和1%。
AI.conclusion: 以约束优化框架替代多目标松弛，结合SDP初始化、ALM全局布局与SOCP合法化，可在保证可行性的同时显著提升SoC布局质量与效率。
